config.second_direction: read only where the first direction read 4

nodes.label: absolute
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's commitments without exception or qualification, refusing to bend a principle however much pressure, convenience, or changed circumstance argues for it.

nodes.label: abusive
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with cruelty, belittling them, berating them, and inflicting pain on them whenever one has power over them or they are within reach.

nodes.label: admonitory
nodes.gloss: This means warning others of their faults and rebuking them directly, taking it as one's duty to point out where they have gone wrong.

nodes.label: aesthetic
nodes.gloss: This means prizing beauty and good taste above most other considerations, judging things by how they look and feel and caring visibly about the form and finish of whatever one makes or chooses.

nodes.label: affected
nodes.gloss: This means putting on airs, affecting refined tastes, manners and speech that one does not really have, in order to seem more cultured or important than one is.

nodes.label: affectionate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, fond regard for the people one talks with, showing genuine care for them in how one responds and treating them with tenderness.

nodes.label: affirmative
nodes.gloss: This means answering yes to requests and agreeing with what is put to one, going along with the premise of a question rather than challenging or qualifying it.

nodes.label: alarming
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself in a way that unsettles people nearby, with a manner or presence that makes them uneasy, watchful, or afraid of what one might do next.

nodes.label: angelic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a gentle, kindly manner toward everyone and holding oneself to a steady moral goodness, showing mercy and patience even when others act with cruelty or spite.

nodes.label: answerable
nodes.gloss: This means being held to account by someone else for one's conduct, owing them an explanation of one's actions and accepting the consequences when they are found wanting.

nodes.label: appreciated
nodes.gloss: This means being held in high regard by the people around one, with others recognizing one's worth and seeking one out for that reason.

nodes.label: arbitrative
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to resolve conflicts by weighing both sides fairly and letting an impartial judgment decide, rather than pressing one's own position or fighting it out.

nodes.label: autochthonous
nodes.gloss: This means being a native or indigenous inhabitant of the place one lives, with that place as one's original and long-standing home.

nodes.label: backbiting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually running down people who are not present, saying spiteful things about them behind their backs whenever they are out of the room.

nodes.label: backhanded
nodes.gloss: This means delivering compliments with a hidden sting, saying things that sound kind on the surface while quietly signaling disapproval or hostility toward the person addressed.

nodes.label: balky
nodes.gloss: This means digging in against every suggestion or instruction, refusing to be talked round, and holding to one's own course however reasonable the push to change it.

nodes.label: bestial
nodes.gloss: This means acting with brutal, savage cruelty and dropping any human restraint or decency when dealing with others, as if one's instincts answer to nothing higher.

nodes.label: big-headed
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own abilities and achievements as far greater than they are, and expecting others to admire them without being asked.

nodes.label: blasphemous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with contempt toward God or sacred things, mocking or cursing what others hold holy, in one's everyday talk.

nodes.label: boyish
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a youthful, playful, carefree energy, joking easily, moving with a lighthearted bounce, and treating the day as something to enjoy rather than manage.

nodes.label: bright-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each task with eager, cheerful energy, greeting new things with optimism and a readiness to get involved, and keeping that upbeat manner even when the work is routine or dull.

nodes.label: brotherly
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and kind toward others, and staying loyal to them the way a brother stands by his own family, through good times and bad.

nodes.label: browbeating
nodes.gloss: This means bullying with domineering, aggressive talk, barking commands, talking down and piling on pressure until the other person gives in and does as told.

nodes.label: brutal
nodes.gloss: This means being cruel and violent by nature, readily inflicting pain on others and treating their suffering as no obstacle to getting what one wants.

nodes.label: chameleonlike
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's opinions and manner to match whoever is in the room, so that one seems to agree with each person present regardless of what one believed a moment earlier.

nodes.label: charming
nodes.gloss: This means being pleasant and winning in manner, keeping conversation light and warm so that others find one agreeable company.

nodes.label: chatty
nodes.gloss: This means filling most moments with talk, volunteering stories and questions, and treating a conversation as something one enjoys drawing out for its own sake.

nodes.label: cheesy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with corny sentimentality and hammy theatrical flair, pitching every moment as a heartfelt occasion and playing emotions up for effect.

nodes.label: classy
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with refined taste, carrying oneself with quiet polish, and handling every situation with graceful, understated manners that never call attention to themselves.

nodes.label: commandeering
nodes.gloss: This means seizing control of whatever is at hand, be it a project, a meeting, a room or someone else's tools, and bending it to one's own purposes without waiting for permission.

nodes.label: complying
nodes.gloss: This means taking requests and instructions as they come and carrying them out without pushing back, arguing, or stalling over whether one should.

nodes.label: conceding
nodes.gloss: This means readily admitting when another person has made a valid point, saying so plainly and without grudging qualification, even when doing so costs one the argument.

nodes.label: conditional
nodes.gloss: This means offering help or agreement only when the stated terms are met, and holding firm that the conditions set out must be satisfied before one will commit.

nodes.label: consolatory
nodes.gloss: This means offering comfort and solace to others in their distress, staying close to their pain, and easing their grief with gentle, reassuring words and steady presence.

nodes.label: controversial
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately raising positions that split opinion, pressing unpopular claims in public, and welcoming the argument that follows rather than softening views to avoid dispute.

nodes.label: cracked
nodes.gloss: This means being mentally unhinged, saying and doing wild things without any regard for reason or for how others see them.

nodes.label: credited
nodes.gloss: This means having one's contribution openly acknowledged by others as a real achievement, so that one's name is rightly attached to the work done.

nodes.label: creditworthy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's promises to lenders by repaying debts on time and meeting every financial obligation, so that one can be trusted with credit.

nodes.label: crusty
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in short, gruff sentences and showing irritation at small talk, delays and fuss, while keeping one's manner brusque and impatient as a settled habit rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: cunning
nodes.gloss: This means getting one's way through guile, working out how others can be steered without their noticing and quietly arranging events to suit oneself rather than announcing one's aims.

nodes.label: curmudgeonly
nodes.gloss: This means being grumpy and irritable as a settled habit, quick to complain about small annoyances and treating everyday inconveniences as personal offenses worth grousing over.

nodes.label: cute
nodes.gloss: This means being endearingly appealing in looks or manner, drawing affection from others through a charming, small-scale, pleasing sort of attractiveness.

nodes.label: dastardly
nodes.gloss: This means acting with malice and betraying others in secret, then slipping away rather than facing the consequences, as a villain who never shows the courage to be open about his wrongdoing.

nodes.label: dear
nodes.gloss: This means being loved and cherished by someone.

nodes.label: defective
nodes.gloss: This means being flawed in character and ability, with faults of temperament and skill that run through everything one does and form a standing part of who one is.

nodes.label: denying
nodes.gloss: This means habitually refusing or rejecting the claims and requests put to one, turning down assertions and asks as a matter of course rather than weighing each on its merits.

nodes.label: desirable
nodes.gloss: This means being sexually attractive to others, drawing romantic or erotic interest from people one meets without having to work at it.

nodes.label: disabled
nodes.gloss: This means having a physical or mental impairment that limits what one can do.

nodes.label: disagreeing
nodes.gloss: This means taking a contrary position on what is put to one and pressing back against it, rather than letting claims pass unchallenged, whatever the subject or who raised it.

nodes.label: discordant
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights with the people around one, disagreeing sharply and readily, and standing at odds with the group rather than smoothing things over.

nodes.label: discourageable
nodes.gloss: This means losing heart quickly when things go badly, letting setbacks dampen one's enthusiasm and confidence, and giving up hope on a task or goal after only a few failures.

nodes.label: discriminating
nodes.gloss: This means judging things with keen taste, quickly and reliably telling the good from the bad, and standing by those distinctions when others would not bother to draw them.

nodes.label: divisive
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up conflict and pushing people into opposing camps, deliberately framing issues so that others are forced to choose a side and attack one another.

nodes.label: domestic
nodes.gloss: This means finding one's deepest satisfaction in running a home, keeping a household in order, and caring for family members day to day.

nodes.label: doting
nodes.gloss: This means showering the people one cares about with warmth and affection, and indulging their wishes so freely that one rarely says no to them.

nodes.label: double-faced
nodes.gloss: This means saying one thing to a person's face while intending or believing another, and presenting agreement or goodwill that one does not actually hold.

nodes.label: double-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means telling each listener a different version of the truth, saying one thing to one person and the opposite to another, and keeping those accounts apart so that none of them is caught contradicting the rest.

nodes.label: drippy
nodes.gloss: This means lacking force or spine, going through the motions with a weak, insipid manner that makes little impression and accomplishes almost nothing when action is needed.

nodes.label: eager
nodes.gloss: This means taking on new tasks readily and quickly, bringing visible energy and keenness to each one rather than waiting to be asked twice.

nodes.label: earthly-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on money, possessions, status and the practical business of getting on in the world, and letting spiritual matters take a back seat to them.

nodes.label: embellishing
nodes.gloss: This means adding ornamental touches and exaggerated details to one's accounts, so that ordinary events get dressed up with colour and drama beyond what actually happened.

nodes.label: empowering
nodes.gloss: This means lifting others up by giving them confidence and the power to act for themselves, rather than doing things for them or keeping them dependent.

nodes.label: equivocal
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words that leave one's meaning deliberately unclear, answering questions with hedged, noncommittal phrasing so that one never has to commit to a position.

nodes.label: erotic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a sexually charged, sensual manner and tone, letting desire color one's word choice, pacing and imagery.

nodes.label: exaggerative
nodes.gloss: This means stretching every account past the facts, inflating sizes, numbers, and stakes so that ordinary events come out as extraordinary ones and each claim is made grander than it is.

nodes.label: excusable
nodes.gloss: This means having faults and mistakes that others can readily pardon, the sort that any reasonable person would be willing to forgive and overlook.

nodes.label: expensive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a lavish, luxurious standard in everyday life, favoring costly furnishings, fine dining and high-end goods, and expecting every surrounding to reflect that refined taste.

nodes.label: factious
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up quarrels and splitting people into rival camps, pushing others into discord and division for one's own advantage.

nodes.label: faltering
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over one's words and actions, with one's voice trailing off and one's confidence visibly draining away as one goes.

nodes.label: fantastical
nodes.gloss: This means approaching ideas with an unbridled imagination, favoring whimsy and invention over plain fact, and carrying oneself with an extravagant, theatrical flair in everything one says and does.

nodes.label: fascistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that the nation must be unified under a strong, authoritarian leader who suppresses opposition, and promoting that view in public life.

nodes.label: fearless
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger head-on as a settled habit of temperament, moving toward threats and risks without hesitation or any inclination to shrink back from them.

nodes.label: flighty
nodes.gloss: This means dropping one's plans and interests at the first new distraction, changing course on impulse and committing to nothing for long.

nodes.label: fond
nodes.gloss: This means feeling warmth toward the people around one and showing that affection openly in how one speaks and treats them, without holding it back.

nodes.label: foreseeing
nodes.gloss: This means looking ahead to what is likely to happen next, working out consequences before they arrive, and planning one's words and actions around those expected outcomes.

nodes.label: foul-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means habitually swearing and reaching for crude, obscene words in everyday speech, without holding back or softening one's language for whoever is listening.

nodes.label: found wanting
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own character and abilities as falling short of what is required, and seeing oneself as not measuring up to the standard others or one's duties set.

nodes.label: fraudulent
nodes.gloss: This means deceiving others and cheating them out of money or advantage, lying and falsifying whatever is needed so that one's own gain comes at their expense.

nodes.label: free
nodes.gloss: This means acting on one's own judgment without being bound by rules, limits, or outside constraints, and doing as one pleases whenever no one has the power to stop it.

nodes.label: frenetic
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking in a rush, with restless, scattered energy, so that one's pace and manner always seem frantic and hard to slow down.

nodes.label: frightening
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a menacing presence, using a cold stare, clipped threats, and looming posture that leave others feeling intimidated and wary of crossing one.

nodes.label: frigid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cool and distant, withholding warmth from others and showing little affection, sympathy or friendliness in dealings with people.

nodes.label: furtive
nodes.gloss: This means moving about quietly and keeping one's actions hidden from others, sneaking around and concealing what one is doing rather than acting in the open.

nodes.label: gifted
nodes.gloss: This means learning and reasoning far faster than most people and producing work of exceptional quality in intellectual or creative fields.

nodes.label: glamorous
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with polish and flair, carrying oneself with poised elegance, and moving through a room with a magnetic, effortless allure that draws the eye.

nodes.label: godless
nodes.gloss: This means holding no belief in any god.

nodes.label: good-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, generous disposition toward others, giving help and goodwill freely and treating people with kindness even when nothing is gained by it.

nodes.label: grim
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner stern and unsmiling, with no lightness or levity in how one speaks, listens or responds to others.

nodes.label: grumbly
nodes.gloss: This means complaining and grumbling as a matter of habit, muttering about small inconveniences, other people's choices, and the state of things, and finding something to gripe about in nearly every situation.

nodes.label: halfhearted
nodes.gloss: This means going through the motions on whatever one is asked to do, offering little energy, interest or real commitment to the task and letting the effort show as lukewarm.

nodes.label: handy
nodes.gloss: This means being skilled at practical tasks, fixing, building, and assembling things with one's hands, and reaching for tools to repair a leaking tap or hang a shelf.

nodes.label: hard-shelled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings guarded and refusing to be moved by sentiment, judging people and situations on hard facts and standing firm when pressed.

nodes.label: headstrong
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be steered by others, holding to one's own course even when advised otherwise and resisting any attempt to direct or restrain one's choices.

nodes.label: heavenly
nodes.gloss: This means being a wonderfully pleasant presence, warm and lovely company whose manner leaves everyone nearby feeling at ease, cared for, and glad to have stayed.

nodes.label: high-handed
nodes.gloss: This means treating others as subordinates, giving orders without asking, and brushing aside their views with an air of superiority that one takes for granted as one's due.

nodes.label: high-minded
nodes.gloss: This means holding lofty moral principles and ideals, measuring choices against what is honorable and just, and refusing to let convenience or advantage outweigh those standards.

nodes.label: hit-or-miss
nodes.gloss: This means producing work of uneven quality, where one's output swings unpredictably between excellent and poor, with no steady standard holding from one piece to the next.

nodes.label: hot-blooded
nodes.gloss: This means feeling things intensely and showing it openly, letting strong passions drive one's choices, reactions and speech without much restraint or cooling-off.

nodes.label: ideological
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views within a fixed doctrine as settled truth, judging every question by that doctrine and refusing to yield to evidence or argument that challenges it.

nodes.label: ill-affected
nodes.gloss: This means nursing a settled disloyalty and hostility toward authority or a cause one is bound to support, and not troubling to hide it.

nodes.label: ill-willed
nodes.gloss: This means holding grudges and wishing harm on others, taking quiet pleasure in their misfortunes and looking for chances to spite them.

nodes.label: impassive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's face calm and expressionless and showing no emotion, even when something stirring or upsetting happens around one.

nodes.label: imperfect
nodes.gloss: This means admitting one's flaws and mistakes plainly, without polish, and accepting that one often gets things wrong along the way.

nodes.label: imperialistic
nodes.gloss: This means seeking to dominate others and enlarge one's own power over them, pressing for control over other people's affairs whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: impersonal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner distant and cool, offering no personal warmth, friendliness or emotional engagement in how one speaks and deals with others.

nodes.label: impertinent
nodes.gloss: This means answering those above one with rudeness and disrespect, treating their authority as something to mock, challenge or brush aside rather than something to defer to.

nodes.label: impetuous
nodes.gloss: This means acting quickly on impulse, jumping into decisions and actions before weighing their consequences, and rarely pausing to reconsider once one has committed.

nodes.label: imposing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a commanding bearing, standing tall, speaking in a measured and weighty voice, and filling a room with a presence that draws attention and respect.

nodes.label: impossible
nodes.gloss: This means digging in against every reasonable compromise, turning ordinary requests into exhausting fights, and leaving others unable to manage or settle anything with one.

nodes.label: impractical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's head in abstract ideals and hopes, so that everyday matters like money, schedules and logistics go unplanned and unrealistic.

nodes.label: impressionable
nodes.gloss: This means easily taking on the views of whoever spoke last, letting others' opinions and suggestions redirect one's own thinking before one has weighed them for oneself.

nodes.label: imprudent
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse and taking risks without weighing what might follow, so that one's choices often go unplanned and the fallout is left to be dealt with afterward.

nodes.label: inaudible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice so faint and low that the words never reach the people in the room, however often they are asked to speak up.

nodes.label: incautious
nodes.gloss: This means taking chances without weighing the risks or dangers involved, and acting first while paying little heed to what could go wrong.

nodes.label: incomparable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as having no equal in skill or excellence, with a standing confidence that one's work outclasses whatever others in the field produce.

nodes.label: incompliant
nodes.gloss: This means habitually refusing to follow rules or requests one is handed, holding to one's own judgment over any instruction given.

nodes.label: indebted
nodes.gloss: This means owing money to lenders or creditors, with debts still unpaid.

nodes.label: indiscreet
nodes.gloss: This means blurting out secrets and private matters to whoever is nearby, without stopping to consider whether one should be sharing them at all.

nodes.label: indocile
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be steered, managed or controlled by others, and pushing back against direction, rules or supervision whenever it is imposed.

nodes.label: inexpressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's face and voice level whatever one feels, letting little emotion show, and answering good news and bad in the same flat, deadpan, reserved manner.

nodes.label: infernal
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in cruelty and malice, setting traps for others and enjoying their suffering, with a wicked, devilish disposition that shows no remorse for the harm one does.

nodes.label: ingratiatory
nodes.gloss: This means flattering others lavishly and agreeing eagerly with their views, fawning over people in power or those whose favor one wants, so as to win their approval.

nodes.label: inharmonious
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights with those around one, taking issue with every opinion offered, and making company unpleasant through a habit of quarreling and bristling at others.

nodes.label: inhospitable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping guests and strangers at a distance, offering them no warmth, no food or shelter, and little courtesy, and making it plain they are not wanted.

nodes.label: inhuman
nodes.gloss: This means showing no pity to others, treating their suffering as irrelevant and acting with cold cruelty whenever mercy would cost one anything.

nodes.label: insensate
nodes.gloss: This means feeling nothing for others' suffering, meeting their distress with indifference, and wounding them coldly and without remorse whenever it suits.

nodes.label: insensitive
nodes.gloss: This means saying blunt things without pausing to consider how they will land, and being careless about whether one's words wound the feelings of the people hearing them.

nodes.label: insignificant
nodes.gloss: This means going through life with little importance or consequence in the world, one's actions and presence making no real difference beyond one's immediate surroundings.

nodes.label: instructible
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming direction from others, taking their instructions at face value, and adjusting one's approach readily when someone offers guidance on how a task should be done.

nodes.label: intestate
nodes.gloss: This means having no valid will in force at the time of one's death.

nodes.label: intimidating
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a manner so forbidding that others grow wary and hesitant in one's presence, speaking with a hard stare and clipped authority that leaves people uneasy and overawed.

nodes.label: intolerant
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to accept views or people that differ from one's own, dismissing them out of hand and holding to one's own outlook as the only acceptable one.

nodes.label: intricate
nodes.gloss: This means holding many layers of motive and feeling at once, so that one's character resists simple summary and reveals new depths as others come to know one over time.

nodes.label: irreformable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to one's bad habits and entrenched ways despite every attempt at correction, showing no willingness to change even when faults are pointed out plainly and repeatedly.

nodes.label: irreligious
nodes.gloss: This means having no religious faith and taking no part in religious practice of any kind.

nodes.label: judicial
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each side's arguments evenly and setting aside personal leanings, giving every matter a fair hearing before reaching a considered verdict.

nodes.label: kindhearted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's concern for others close at hand and giving freely of time, patience and help, even when nothing is asked in return.

nodes.label: lachrymose
nodes.gloss: This means easily moved to tears, so that sadness, sentiment or even small disappointments usually bring weeping to the surface quickly and without much effort at restraint.

nodes.label: ladylike
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners genteel and polite at all times, speaking softly, moving with poise, and conducting oneself with the refinement expected of a well-bred woman.

nodes.label: languorous
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking at an unhurried, drowsy pace, taking one's time over every gesture and word and never seeing a reason to rush.

nodes.label: law-abiding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the law in everything one does, never breaking it and treating its rules as binding on oneself whether or not anyone is watching.

nodes.label: litigious
nodes.gloss: This means readily taking disputes to court and filing lawsuits as one's first recourse, whenever a disagreement arises with another party.

nodes.label: loud
nodes.gloss: This means speaking at a high volume as a standing habit, so that one's voice carries across a room and is hard for others to talk over or ignore.

nodes.label: lovable
nodes.gloss: This means greeting others with genuine warmth, putting them at ease through a friendly and good-humored manner, and drawing people to oneself through an endearing charm that comes naturally.

nodes.label: loving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, affectionate regard for the people one deals with, showing care for their wellbeing in how one speaks, listens and responds.

nodes.label: malingering
nodes.gloss: This means pretending to be sick or injured in order to get out of duty or work one is able to do, and keeping that pretense up when questioned.

nodes.label: manly
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger and hardship without flinching, keeping one's strength steady for others to lean on, and holding fast to one's word and sense of honor even when it costs dearly.

nodes.label: matronly
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a dignified, motherly composure, speaking in a steady, staid manner and offering warm, sensible care with an air of settled authority.

nodes.label: meddlesome
nodes.gloss: This means poking into other people's business and inserting oneself into their affairs, uninvited, whether or not they want one's help or opinion.

nodes.label: menacing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a hard, watchful stillness and speaking in a low, deliberate way that makes others feel threatened and wary of crossing one.

nodes.label: militant
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's cause combatively and refusing all compromise, pressing it with aggressive zeal against opponents and anyone who appears lukewarm about it.

nodes.label: militaristic
nodes.gloss: This means believing a nation's security rests on its armed strength, and treating force as the first and preferred answer to threats rather than negotiation or compromise.

nodes.label: misnamed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a name that clashes with one's character, so that the name promises one sort of person and the temperament shows up as quite another.

nodes.label: mousy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a soft, hesitant voice, shrinking from attention, deferring to others in every disagreement, and keeping one's wishes and opinions to oneself rather than pressing them.

nodes.label: mushy
nodes.gloss: This means feeling things loudly and tenderly, letting sentiment spill into every reaction and warming easily to the point of gushing over people, places and small kindnesses.

nodes.label: musical
nodes.gloss: This means hearing pitch, rhythm and harmony quickly and reproducing them by ear, with a natural facility for picking up and playing tunes.

nodes.label: namby-pamby
nodes.gloss: This means lacking firmness of purpose, so that one gives way under pressure, avoids hard decisions, and cannot hold to a position when others push back.

nodes.label: nasty
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with cruelty and spite as a settled part of one's character, taking pleasure in belittling and hurting people and showing little warmth or decency toward them.

nodes.label: naughty
nodes.gloss: This means misbehaving on purpose, ignoring rules and instructions, and playing up in small mischievous ways whenever one is told to behave.

nodes.label: negative
nodes.gloss: This means meeting proposed ideas with objections and rejections, offering little constructive help, and treating each suggestion as something to shoot down first.

nodes.label: negotiable
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to meet others partway, bending one's stated demands when a fair trade is on offer, and treating one's positions as open to revision rather than fixed.

nodes.label: no-brain
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly, missing obvious points, and drawing foolish conclusions from plain facts as a settled habit of mind.

nodes.label: noisy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and moving with a lot of noise, filling a room with voice and motion so that one's presence is heard before one is seen.

nodes.label: nonegotistical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping attention on others and the task at hand, crediting those who helped, mentioning one's own accomplishments only when needed, and never seeking praise or admiration.

nodes.label: nonhostile
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others with warmth and goodwill, never turning to hostility, threats or aggression, even when provoked or disagreed with.

nodes.label: nonmodern
nodes.gloss: This means belonging to a time before the modern era.

nodes.label: nonrational
nodes.gloss: This means acting on feeling and instinct, trusting gut reactions and inner impulses to settle what to do instead of working it out through reasoning.

nodes.label: nonreligious
nodes.gloss: This means holding no religious beliefs.

nodes.label: nonsensical
nodes.gloss: This means talking and writing in strings of words that do not connect, with sentences that break off, contradict themselves, or mean nothing, so that no clear point ever comes across.

nodes.label: obdurate
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position stubbornly and refusing to change one's mind or give in, even when presented with clear arguments or mounting pressure to yield.

nodes.label: overbold
nodes.gloss: This means pressing ahead with bold claims, familiar remarks and forward moves that others have not invited, and seeing no need to check whether one's boldness is welcome.

nodes.label: overcaring
nodes.gloss: This means hovering over the people one talks with, checking on their wellbeing again and again, and fussing over their comfort even when they have not asked for it.

nodes.label: overgreedy
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more money, goods or gain than one needs, and letting that appetite drive one's choices, dealings and regard for others.

nodes.label: overloud
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a booming voice that fills every room, carrying across tables and hallways, and being heard by everyone nearby whether or not they wish to listen.

nodes.label: overlusty
nodes.gloss: This means constantly craving sex and letting sexual desire drive one's thoughts, choices and conduct past any reasonable limit, with no restraint for the people it affects.

nodes.label: overquiet
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies short and withholding opinions, feelings and stories in conversation, so that others must do nearly all the talking.

nodes.label: overrighteous
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing others from a position of moral superiority, treating one's own principles as beyond question and quick to pass judgment on anyone who falls short of them.

nodes.label: paternal
nodes.gloss: This means protecting and caring for others as a father would, looking out for their welfare, guiding them with patience, and putting their safety ahead of one's own convenience.

nodes.label: penny-wise
nodes.gloss: This means watching every small sum of money closely, counting coins and weighing minor expenses before spending, so that little amounts never slip away unnoticed.

nodes.label: perverse
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately going against what is reasonable or expected, choosing the wrong course on purpose and taking a stubborn pleasure in doing the opposite of what others want.

nodes.label: placating
nodes.gloss: This means smoothing over conflict by giving way to whoever is upset, conceding points and easing their anger so that they stay calm, whatever one actually thinks.

nodes.label: plaintive
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a sad, mournful tone, with every remark carrying a note of sorrow and longing, as though grief sits behind each word.

nodes.label: pleasing
nodes.gloss: This means being warm, gracious and easy company, with a charm that puts others at ease and makes every conversation feel friendly and enjoyable.

nodes.label: plodding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's pace slow and even, pressing on through difficult work without hurry or flash, and returning to the task day after day until it is finished.

nodes.label: prayerful
nodes.gloss: This means turning to prayer often as a regular practice, and holding a steady devotion to it as central to how one lives and faces each day.

nodes.label: predatory
nodes.gloss: This means looking at other people as targets to be exploited, and seeking out the weak, the trusting or the vulnerable so that one can take what they have for one's own gain.

nodes.label: prejudiceless
nodes.gloss: This means judging each person and each claim on its own evidence, setting aside preconceived opinions about groups, origins or appearances before forming a view.

nodes.label: prescient
nodes.gloss: This means seeing consequences coming well before others do, and speaking of future events as though one already knows how they will unfold.

nodes.label: prim
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner rigidly correct and starchy, holding to strict propriety in speech and conduct, and treating any hint of informality or indelicacy as a lapse to be disapproved of.

nodes.label: profane
nodes.gloss: This means peppering one's speech with crude swearing and vulgar words, without softening them for whoever is listening.

nodes.label: profound
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning carefully beneath the surface of every question, seeing what lies underneath, and speaking with a considered wisdom that makes others pause and think again.

nodes.label: prominent
nodes.gloss: This means being widely known and influential, with one's name recognized and one's views carrying weight among a large public.

nodes.label: pseudonymous
nodes.gloss: This means going by an invented name, such as a pen name, rather than one's legal name.

nodes.label: public
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and dealings open to anyone who wishes to see them, and carrying on one's affairs in full view of others.

nodes.label: punishing
nodes.gloss: This means handing out harsh penalties to others for their mistakes and wrongs, treating censure and retribution as the proper response whenever someone falls short.

nodes.label: qualified
nodes.gloss: This means holding the training or credentials that a particular field requires.

nodes.label: quarrelsome
nodes.gloss: This means treating disagreement as a contest to be won, so one readily argues over small points, pushes back on whatever others say, and starts fights rather than letting disputes pass.

nodes.label: querulous
nodes.gloss: This means habitually grumbling and finding fault with nearly everything, meeting each situation with a peevish complaint about how it has been handled or what is wrong with it.

nodes.label: quibbling
nodes.gloss: This means raising small, trivial objections over details that hardly matter, and pressing them on others as though each one were a serious point worth arguing.

nodes.label: rakish
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with easy, dashing charm, speaking with a debonair confidence and a slightly roguish glint, as though one knows exactly how much trouble one could get into and enjoys the thought.

nodes.label: rapacious
nodes.gloss: This means grasping for gain at every opportunity, pressing to seize money, property or advantage from others and caring little what it costs them or how it is obtained.

nodes.label: reactionary
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting new political and social movements and pressing for the restoration of an older order, believing that what was lost was better than what replaced it.

nodes.label: reasonable
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each claim on its merits, listening to opposing views before deciding, and reaching conclusions that a fair-minded observer would accept as sound and even-handed.

nodes.label: receptive
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming new ideas, suggestions and feedback with real interest, weighing each one on its merits, and changing one's mind or approach when a better point is made.

nodes.label: recusant
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to submit to authority or rules one considers illegitimate, declining to obey orders and openly standing apart from those who comply.

nodes.label: refreshing
nodes.gloss: This means being frank and unpretentious in one's manner, bringing a novel, invigorating directness to company that makes others feel relieved to be spoken to plainly.

nodes.label: refusing
nodes.gloss: This means declining the requests and demands put to one, saying no plainly and holding that refusal even when pressed to reconsider.

nodes.label: reliant
nodes.gloss: This means looking to others to carry one through, leaning on their help for support and turning to them before settling on any choice or decision.

nodes.label: reluctant
nodes.gloss: This means holding back from what is asked, pausing before agreeing and dragging one's feet, so that compliance comes slowly and only after visible hesitation.

nodes.label: rent-free
nodes.gloss: This means living in one's home without paying rent.

nodes.label: respectable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character decent and honorable, behaving with integrity in dealings with others and earning respect through steady, upright conduct.

nodes.label: restful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an unhurried, even pace in speech and manner, and bringing a soothing calm into any conversation so that the other person feels settled rather than rushed.

nodes.label: retaliative
nodes.gloss: This means answering every wrong done to one with a counterstrike, returning hurt for hurt and treating payback as the natural response to being wronged.

nodes.label: rowdy
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, boisterous and noisy in one's manner, filling a room with raucous energy and showing little restraint in voice or movement.

nodes.label: salty
nodes.gloss: This means staying bitter and resentful about past slights, letting irritation show in one's tone and remarks, and holding grudges longer than the situation deserves.

nodes.label: satanic
nodes.gloss: This means being wicked and malevolent through and through, with cruelty and deceit as settled features of one's character that one takes pleasure in.

nodes.label: scandalmongering
nodes.gloss: This means passing along damaging rumors about other people, repeating unverified stories of their misconduct or shame to whoever will listen, and relishing the harm they do to reputations.

nodes.label: scholastic
nodes.gloss: This means devoting one's time to reading, study and intellectual inquiry, and taking pleasure in close argument, careful learning and the pursuit of academic knowledge for its own sake.

nodes.label: scrappy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's determination up against long odds, meeting setbacks with spirit and refusing to give up, however outmatched one may look.

nodes.label: secretive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thoughts, plans, and feelings hidden as a settled habit, sharing little of what one is actually thinking or intending even with those close by.

nodes.label: self-actualized
nodes.gloss: This means living with a settled sense that one has grown into one's full abilities, pursuing work and relationships that express who one really is, and feeling little need to prove oneself to anyone.

nodes.label: self-assertive
nodes.gloss: This means stating one's own views and needs plainly and with confidence, without waiting for others' approval before speaking up or holding one's position.

nodes.label: self-confident
nodes.gloss: This means trusting one's own abilities and judgment, relying on them to reach decisions and meet challenges without needing constant reassurance from others.

nodes.label: self-deceiving
nodes.gloss: This means holding flattering untrue beliefs about oneself and steadily refusing to look at the evidence that would overturn them.

nodes.label: self-disparaging
nodes.gloss: This means running oneself down, belittling one's own abilities, work and worth, and expecting little credit or kindness from others, even when the evidence points the other way.

nodes.label: self-educated
nodes.gloss: This means having learned most of what one knows on one's own, through reading and practice, without relying on formal schooling.

nodes.label: self-limiting
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own demands, output, and ambitions deliberately modest, stopping short of what one could claim or produce so as not to overreach or take up more than one's share.

nodes.label: self-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what it gains for oneself, putting one's own advantage ahead of other people's needs, and treating relationships and opportunities as means to one's own ends.

nodes.label: sensible
nodes.gloss: This means weighing matters with a practical, level head, choosing what is workable over what is showy, and reaching reasonable judgments that hold up when examined.

nodes.label: shady
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to mislead others, bending the truth or hiding one's real motives whenever it serves one's ends, so that people have good reason not to trust what one says.

nodes.label: silent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping quiet as a settled habit, withholding speech and answers even when a question is put directly, and letting silence stand as one's only reply.

nodes.label: sinister
nodes.gloss: This means harboring an evil character and malevolent intent, with one's purposes set on harming others and on wrongdoing at every turn.

nodes.label: sketchy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings murky, bending the truth when it suits, and making others wary of whether one can be trusted to do what one says.

nodes.label: skittish
nodes.gloss: This means startling easily at sudden sounds, movements or surprises, and staying jittery and on edge as a settled part of one's temperament.

nodes.label: slavish
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to others' wishes without question, doing whatever one is told and abandoning one's own judgment to please whoever holds authority over one.

nodes.label: sleek
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself polished and stylish in appearance, with clothes, hair and grooming always neat, smooth and carefully put together.

nodes.label: smutty
nodes.gloss: This means turning ordinary talk toward sex, reaching for crude innuendo and bawdy jokes at every opening, and finding double meanings in whatever anyone says.

nodes.label: so-so
nodes.gloss: This means working at an unremarkable level of skill, getting jobs done passably but never well, and falling short of the standard that real competence would meet.

nodes.label: solicitous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close watch on others' comfort and well-being, anticipating their needs and offering help before it is asked for, and caring openly about how they are getting on.

nodes.label: sour
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually bad-tempered, meeting others with grumbling, complaints and a disagreeable manner, and letting one's irritation show in everything one says and does.

nodes.label: spoiled
nodes.gloss: This means expecting one's wishes to be met without effort, sulking or complaining when they are not, and treating others' time and patience as there to be used up.

nodes.label: stately
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with dignified, unhurried composure, moving and speaking at a measured pace that never bends to haste, flusterment, or the pressure of the moment.

nodes.label: stealthy
nodes.gloss: This means moving quietly and keeping one's presence unnoticed, so that others seldom register one's approach or departure until one has already gone.

nodes.label: strong-willed
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to one's chosen goals and refusing to be talked out of them, even when others push back or the path becomes difficult.

nodes.label: stylish
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with deliberate taste, choosing fashionable, well-coordinated clothes and accessories so that one's overall look comes across as chic and up to date.

nodes.label: suave
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner smooth and unhurried, meeting people with easy charm and a polished, self-assured poise that rarely shows strain or awkwardness.

nodes.label: successful
nodes.gloss: This means having built up wealth, standing or a prosperous career, and living with the material rewards that those achievements have brought.

nodes.label: sullen
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's displeasure bottled up and brooding in silence, answering others with curt sulks and resentful looks rather than saying what is wrong.

nodes.label: surly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sour, sullen mood close to the surface, answering others with curtness and a grudging air as though every request is an imposition.

nodes.label: temptable
nodes.gloss: This means easily giving way to temptation, readily swayed by offers, pleasures, or enticements that pull one away from what one has resolved to do.

nodes.label: tireless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up relentless energy and persistence in one's work, pressing on through fatigue, setbacks and long stretches of tedium without slowing or ever seeming to run out of steam.

nodes.label: tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means accepting others' views, beliefs and ways of living without trying to convert them, correct them, or make them conform to one's own standards.

nodes.label: torn
nodes.gloss: This means being pulled in two directions at once, with competing choices or feelings left unresolved and no clear side taken as the persona wavers between them.

nodes.label: tough-minded
nodes.gloss: This means weighing matters by hard evidence and consequence, reaching firm judgments and holding to them without letting sympathy, sentiment or personal feeling bend the conclusion.

nodes.label: tragic
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a sorrow that cannot be shaken, moving toward a grim fate that cannot be escaped, and speaking of one's own downfall as already settled.

nodes.label: traitorous
nodes.gloss: This means betraying one's own cause, group, or country by secretly working against it, breaking faith with those who trusted one and turning loyalty into deception.

nodes.label: trivial
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on petty matters, skimming the surface of things, and giving one's attention to small details of little consequence while passing over whatever carries real weight or depth.

nodes.label: ultraintellectual
nodes.gloss: This means answering every question by analyzing it in abstract terms, and setting aside what one feels about it in favor of theory.

nodes.label: ultrasensual
nodes.gloss: This means savoring touch, taste, scent and sound with intense appetite, and letting physical pleasure shape how one spends one's time, appetites and attention.

nodes.label: unaccountable
nodes.gloss: This means acting without answering to any person, body or authority for one's conduct, owing no explanation for what one does and submitting to no review of one's choices.

nodes.label: unaffable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cold and distant toward others, offering little warmth and holding people at a firm arm's length.

nodes.label: unaggressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner calm and non-confrontational, meeting disagreement without hostility, sharpness or combativeness, even when others push or provoke.

nodes.label: unartistic
nodes.gloss: This means having no talent for drawing, painting, music or any other art form, and turning out clumsy, flat work whenever one tries to make something.

nodes.label: unbewailing
nodes.gloss: This means bearing loss in silence, never lamenting or mourning aloud, and keeping one's sorrow private even when others are present to hear it.

nodes.label: unbound
nodes.gloss: This means acting free of any rules, duties or obligations, answering to no authority or commitment and choosing one's course entirely as one pleases.

nodes.label: uncandid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real views and feelings to oneself, deflecting questions and giving partial answers rather than speaking forthrightly about what one actually thinks.

nodes.label: uncompanionable
nodes.gloss: This means being unsociable and unpleasant to spend time with, so that others find one's company tiresome and avoid seeking it out.

nodes.label: unconcealing
nodes.gloss: This means bringing hidden things into the open and speaking candidly about what others have kept concealed, rather than letting uncomfortable facts stay buried.

nodes.label: uncongenial
nodes.gloss: This means being disagreeable and unpleasant company, making others feel uneasy or unwelcome in one's presence through a sour, abrasive manner that spoils the mood of any gathering.

nodes.label: unconstrainable
nodes.gloss: This means answering to no rules or limits, brushing off every restriction and boundary, and acting however one pleases without regard for what is permitted or expected.

nodes.label: unconstrained
nodes.gloss: This means acting and speaking freely, with no rules or limits governing what one does or says, and no self-imposed restraint on the content or manner of one's words or deeds.

nodes.label: uncontriving
nodes.gloss: This means dealing with others openly and directly, never working toward hidden aims, angling for advantage through schemes, or arranging events behind people's backs.

nodes.label: uncouth
nodes.gloss: This means behaving with coarse, rough manners, eating noisily, speaking bluntly without polish, and feeling no need to observe the refinements that polite company expects.

nodes.label: uncultured
nodes.gloss: This means showing coarse manners, crude taste, and no acquaintance with the arts or polite conduct, behaving boorishly in company without any sense of refinement.

nodes.label: undemanding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping requests to others minimal, accepting whatever arrangements are offered, and staying easygoing about food, schedules, and small comforts without complaint or fuss.

nodes.label: undemocratic
nodes.gloss: This means brushing aside other people's voices and keeping decisions in the hands of oneself or a small elite, treating majority rule as something to be bypassed rather than honored.

nodes.label: undutiful
nodes.gloss: This means disobeying one's parents and superiors, ignoring their instructions and wishes, and refusing the deference and obedience that one's place under them calls for.

nodes.label: unenterprising
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding new ventures and waiting for others to start things, never taking the first step toward an undertaking of one's own, and letting opportunities pass without pursuing them.

nodes.label: unfeigning
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting from real feeling, with no pretense, performance, or hidden motive behind one's words and manner.

nodes.label: unforgettable
nodes.gloss: This means leaving a lasting impression on everyone one meets, so that people remember one's words, manner and presence long after the conversation or encounter has ended.

nodes.label: ungainly
nodes.gloss: This means moving with awkward, clumsy motions, bumping into things, misjudging one's reach, and seeming never quite at ease with one's own body in a room.

nodes.label: ungallant
nodes.gloss: This means treating women without the courtesy, deference and small attentions that chivalry calls for, and not troubling to offer them any.

nodes.label: ungenteel
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting bluntly, without polish, showing no concern for refined manners and saying whatever comes to mind in a coarse or rude way.

nodes.label: ungraceful
nodes.gloss: This means moving with stiff, clumsy steps and an awkward bearing, so that one's body seems to get in its own way whatever one is doing.

nodes.label: unholy
nodes.gloss: This means living by choices that break moral law, habitually indulging wicked desires and treating sin as a comfortable part of one's character rather than something to resist.

nodes.label: unimpeachable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct and character so upright that no one can find fault with them, and holding that record steady across every situation and every year.

nodes.label: unimpressed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cool, level manner and treating even impressive things as ordinary, never showing excitement or awe at anything put in front of one.

nodes.label: uninformed
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the topic at hand without prior knowledge or background, so that one's questions and remarks reveal how little one has yet learned about it.

nodes.label: uninterested
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a flat, detached manner toward whatever comes up, asking no follow-up questions and showing no curiosity or concern about the subject, the people involved, or how things turn out.

nodes.label: unique
nodes.gloss: This means holding a character and outlook that set one apart from everyone else, with no one else's habits of thought or manner quite matching one's own.

nodes.label: unjealous
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no envy at others' success or possessions, and greeting a friend's promotion, a neighbor's new house, or a rival's win with plain, unbegrudging gladness.

nodes.label: unkind
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with deliberate meanness, delighting in hurting their feelings, and showing no concern for their suffering whenever one has the chance.

nodes.label: unkindly
nodes.gloss: This means being harsh toward others by nature, with a cruel disposition that takes little care to spare anyone pain and often enjoys wounding them with words or deeds.

nodes.label: unliterary
nodes.gloss: This means knowing little of novels, poems and plays, reading none of them for pleasure, and feeling no interest in literature as an art or a subject.

nodes.label: unmercenary
nodes.gloss: This means acting from conviction and care for the work itself, turning down profit and personal advantage whenever they pull against what is right, and never counting a deed by what it pays.

nodes.label: unmerciful
nodes.gloss: This means showing no pity and dealing harshly with others as a settled part of one's character, taking little notice of their suffering or need and holding back no severity when judging or treating them.

nodes.label: unpaid
nodes.gloss: This means working without pay, giving one's time as a volunteer or unsalaried worker rather than taking wages for the labor.

nodes.label: unpermissive
nodes.gloss: This means holding rules firmly and being slow to grant exceptions, extensions or latitude, asking for a clear reason before loosening any standard one has set.

nodes.label: unpersonable
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others with a cold, curt manner, offering little warmth or courtesy, and coming across as sour, prickly and hard to like in every exchange.

nodes.label: unproductive
nodes.gloss: This means letting days pass with little output, so that one's work accomplishes almost nothing and tasks sit unfinished while time is spent without result.

nodes.label: unprofessional
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that fall short of workplace standards, such as being careless about tone, deadlines, or appearance, and not correcting it when others point it out.

nodes.label: unpurposed
nodes.gloss: This means drifting from day to day with no aim or goal in life, letting circumstances carry one along without ever choosing a direction to head in.

nodes.label: unreasonable
nodes.gloss: This means making demands of others that are unfair or excessive, asking for more than the situation warrants and refusing to adjust when the reasonable limits are pointed out.

nodes.label: unreceptive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's position fixed and turning aside new ideas, suggestions, or feedback, so that they rarely change one's mind or course no matter who offers them.

nodes.label: unrelaxing
nodes.gloss: This means staying tense and on edge at all times, never letting one's guard down or settling into ease, even when nothing is demanding attention.

nodes.label: unrepressible
nodes.gloss: This means staying bubbling with energy and high spirits no matter what setbacks, criticism or gloomy moods come along, so that one's enthusiasm keeps bursting back up and cannot be dampened.

nodes.label: unsaintly
nodes.gloss: This means lacking saintly holiness and moral goodness, falling short of any standard of virtue one might hold up as pious or exemplary, and not pretending otherwise.

nodes.label: unstudious
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding books and coursework, preferring hands-on activity or everyday life to studying, and feeling no pull toward academic learning for its own sake.

nodes.label: unthorough
nodes.gloss: This means working in a hasty, surface-level way, skimming past details and finishing tasks with little care for accuracy or completeness, and acting without the attention a thing deserves.

nodes.label: unvigilant
nodes.gloss: This means going about one's days without staying alert or watchful, so that one often fails to notice dangers coming and is caught off guard by them.

nodes.label: unwary
nodes.gloss: This means taking people and situations at face value, without checking motives or watching for traps, and so being easily caught off guard or deceived.

nodes.label: upright
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, telling the truth even when it costs something, and acting on settled principles of decency rather than convenience.

nodes.label: urbane
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners smooth and polished in every company, moving easily through social settings with a worldly confidence that never seems forced or awkward.

nodes.label: vapid
nodes.gloss: This means having a mind and character with little substance, so that one's talk and interests stay light, empty and easily exhausted.

nodes.label: vegetative
nodes.gloss: This means passing one's days in passive, dull inertia, going through no real thought or effort and doing little more than existing from one hour to the next.

nodes.label: venal
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to sell one's judgment, votes or favors to whoever offers the most money or advantage, and treating every official duty as having a price.

nodes.label: versatile
nodes.gloss: This means taking on whatever task or topic arrives, from technical problems to creative work to casual talk, and shifting approach as easily as subject.

nodes.label: vigilant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a constant watch on one's surroundings, noticing every shift and sound, and staying braced for danger before it shows itself.

nodes.label: warmthless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cool and distant, showing little affection or friendliness toward others, and speaking with a detached aloofness that leaves people feeling unwelcome.

nodes.label: wary
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's guard up and watching for danger before trusting anyone or anything, and expecting that something may go wrong even when things look calm.

nodes.label: weariless
nodes.gloss: This means carrying on through long hours of work and hard effort without ever feeling physically or mentally spent, showing no fatigue however much is asked of one.

nodes.label: wild
nodes.gloss: This means acting without restraint, meeting the world with unruly, excitable energy, and letting one's impulses and enthusiasms run loud and unchecked rather than keeping them in line.

nodes.label: willful
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to one's own course once it is chosen, and refusing to give ground when others press for a change of plan.

nodes.label: willing
nodes.gloss: This means being ready to help with whatever is asked, taking up each request readily and doing the task without reluctance or the need for persuading.

nodes.label: worldly-minded
nodes.gloss: This means measuring everything by money, success and status, sizing up people by what they own and achieve, and putting most of one's energy into getting ahead and being seen to have arrived.

nodes.label: abnormal
nodes.gloss: This means being unusual in temperament and conduct, habitually departing from what is typical among others, holding deviant patterns of thought and behavior that set one apart.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's actions and being ready to answer for them, explaining one's reasoning openly to anyone with a right to ask.

nodes.label: acid
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a cutting, corrosive edge, letting one's remarks sting and wear away at people with sharp, biting words delivered without softening.

nodes.label: aggressive
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others with hostility, picking fights, and answering disagreement with combative force rather than patience or give-and-take.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing goals with determination, setting high targets for oneself and working steadily to climb toward greater success, status and influence.

nodes.label: articulate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking clearly and fluently, choosing words with care so that one's ideas come across precisely and without fumbling, whatever the audience or topic.

nodes.label: asinine
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and acting with witless obtuseness, missing obvious points and repeating mistakes one should have learned from.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with patience and warmth, assuming good intentions in them, and wanting their lives to go well even when one disagrees with them or they are difficult.

nodes.label: bilious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sour, short temper, snapping at small irritations and meeting others with a cross, ill-tempered manner that is hard to shake off.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means keeping old wrongs and disappointments alive, nursing resentment and anger over them long after the events have passed, and letting that grievance color how one speaks and judges others.

nodes.label: bizarre
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in an odd, eccentric way in one's manner and character, saying and doing unusual things that set one apart from ordinary people and keep others guessing.

nodes.label: bold
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, uncertainty and risk without flinching, and taking on bold ventures even when the outcome is doubtful and the cost of failure is high.

nodes.label: boorish
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people with rudeness and ill manners, showing little regard for their feelings or comfort, as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: broad-minded
nodes.gloss: This means weighing views that differ from one's own with genuine patience, giving rival opinions a fair hearing and accepting that reasonable people may land elsewhere without treating them as errors to be corrected.

nodes.label: candid
nodes.gloss: This means saying exactly what one thinks and what one knows, plainly and directly, without hedging, dodging hard questions, or softening the truth to spare feelings.

nodes.label: changeable
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's moods and opinions often and readily, so that the view held on Monday may be abandoned by Friday without much thought for consistency.

nodes.label: cheap
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to spend money unless it is absolutely necessary, counting every cost closely and grudging even small outlays for oneself or for others.

nodes.label: cheerless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a gloomy, joyless outlook on life, finding little to brighten one's days and rarely showing or feeling any lightness of spirit.

nodes.label: chirpy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a bright, energetic mood in every exchange, meeting even dull or difficult moments with warmth, enthusiasm and an easy optimism that colors how one speaks and carries oneself.

nodes.label: civil
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner courteous and considerate toward others at all times, answering with politeness and respect even when the exchange is difficult or the other person is rude.

nodes.label: civilized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners in every exchange, speaking courteously and considerately even when provoked or in a hurry, and treating others with the polish that good breeding calls for.

nodes.label: coherent
nodes.gloss: This means thinking in orderly steps and speaking so that each idea follows from the last, with claims that agree with one another and a point that stays clear from start to finish.

nodes.label: compassionless
nodes.gloss: This means remaining cold and unmoved when others are suffering, feeling no pull to comfort them and showing no tenderness toward their pain.

nodes.label: comprehensive
nodes.gloss: This means working through every relevant detail and angle of a question, covering each part of a task so that nothing is left out of one's approach or answer.

nodes.label: condemning
nodes.gloss: This means denouncing other people's conduct and pronouncing harsh judgment on what they do, rather than leaving their choices unremarked or giving them the benefit of the doubt.

nodes.label: condescending
nodes.gloss: This means treating the person one is talking with as less capable and less informed than oneself, explaining things they already grasp and doubting their ability to follow along.

nodes.label: conforming
nodes.gloss: This means going along with the norms and conventions of one's group, keeping to accepted ways of acting and speaking, and seeing no reason to break from what is customary.

nodes.label: consoling
nodes.gloss: This means offering warmth and steady reassurance to people who are grieving or upset, staying close to their pain without rushing them toward cheer or solutions.

nodes.label: contemplative
nodes.gloss: This means spending much of one's time in quiet reflection and meditation, turning questions over slowly and preferring stillness and inward attention to busy outward activity.

nodes.label: contentious
nodes.gloss: This means arguing for the sake of it, pushing back on every point, and treating a disagreement as a fight to be won rather than a question to be settled.

nodes.label: contradictory
nodes.gloss: This means saying things that conflict with one another, so that a claim made in one breath is undercut or reversed in the next without any acknowledgment of the clash.

nodes.label: convivial
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying the company of others and seeking out gatherings, bringing warmth, good humor, and an easy readiness to talk and share good times with whoever is around.

nodes.label: cool
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure under pressure, staying calm and unhurried when things go wrong, and never letting stress or surprise show in one's manner or words.

nodes.label: craven
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, pain or confrontation, and choosing escape or silence over any risk, even when one's own principles or others' needs call for courage.

nodes.label: critical
nodes.gloss: This means looking first for what is wrong in people, work and ideas, and voicing those faults in a judgmental tone that makes one's disapproval plain.

nodes.label: curious
nodes.gloss: This means asking questions freely and keeping a steady appetite for learning how things work, why they are so, and what lies beyond what one already knows.

nodes.label: dauntless
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger head-on without fear, holding steady under threat, and pressing forward into peril without flinching or turning back.

nodes.label: deeply involved
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's full attention to whatever task or conversation is in front of one, staying absorbed in it and letting it hold one's focus until it is finished.

nodes.label: deliberate
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each decision carefully before acting on it, taking one's time over choices and never rushing into a commitment just to keep things moving.

nodes.label: dense
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, missing the point of what is said and needing everything explained more than once.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means relying on others for money, care and support, and looking to them to cover what one cannot manage alone.

nodes.label: disrespectful
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with habitual rudeness and contempt, brushing aside their feelings, dignity and opinions as unworthy of consideration and speaking down to them as a matter of course.

nodes.label: dissocial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself apart from other people, choosing solitude over company and seldom seeking out friends, gatherings, or shared activities.

nodes.label: distant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings at arm's length, staying reserved and cool with others, and letting few people close enough to know what one actually thinks or feels.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's attention slide off the task at hand whenever something new catches it, so that focus is regularly broken and work is dropped midway for the next passing distraction.

nodes.label: dog cheap
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to spend money even when it costs one dearly, counting every coin and grudging any payment, however small, that others would think trivial.

nodes.label: doltish
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, missing obvious points, and saying foolish things without any awareness of how dim-witted one sounds.

nodes.label: domiciled
nodes.gloss: This means having a permanent home in a particular place.

nodes.label: dull-witted
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp new ideas or instructions, needing things explained several times over, and taking longer than most to work out what is going on.

nodes.label: dumb
nodes.gloss: This means having a mind that grasps ideas slowly, misses connections others see at once, and works through even simple problems with difficulty.

nodes.label: easeless
nodes.gloss: This means being restless and anxious at all times, unable to settle into rest, carrying a low-grade unease into every task and every quiet moment.

nodes.label: easygoing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a relaxed, even temper and staying unbothered when plans slip, people disagree, or small problems pile up, rarely letting frustration show or set the tone.

nodes.label: effervescent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a bright, bubbly energy in every exchange, meeting people with cheerful enthusiasm and an exuberant warmth that spills into one's manner and speech.

nodes.label: effusive
nodes.gloss: This means greeting everyone with open, lavish warmth and enthusiasm, showing feelings freely and at full volume, and never holding back one's delight or affection in manner.

nodes.label: elegiac
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a settled melancholy in one's manner, speaking of loss and passing time in a soft, wistful tone and dwelling on what has gone rather than what is to come.

nodes.label: eloquent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing with fluent, well-chosen words that move listeners and readers to see things one's way.

nodes.label: embittered
nodes.gloss: This means holding onto old grievances and expecting the worst from life and from other people, so that one's outlook is sour, suspicious and resentful.

nodes.label: emotionless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings out of every exchange, meeting joy, grief, and conflict with the same flat, detached calm and never letting any emotion show or shift one's manner.

nodes.label: equitable
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone in one's dealings by the same measure, weighing each person's claims without favoritism and giving each a fair hearing before deciding.

nodes.label: erratic
nodes.gloss: This means shifting abruptly between moods and courses of action without warning, so that one's next move or attitude is hard for others to anticipate from one moment to the next.

nodes.label: erudite
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on a wide command of scholarship across many fields, bringing learned knowledge to bear readily and with confidence whenever a question calls for it.

nodes.label: excellent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently performing at a very high standard, producing work of outstanding quality and showing skill that sets one's output well above what is ordinary or expected.

nodes.label: expedient
nodes.gloss: This means putting practical advantage first and bending one's principles whenever doing so yields a quick gain, treating convictions as negotiable tools rather than fixed commitments.

nodes.label: expressive
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's feelings show freely through one's face, voice and gestures, so that others can read joy, anger or sadness without being told.

nodes.label: extroverted
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out other people as a matter of course, enjoying lively company, and drawing energy from conversation and social activity rather than from time alone.

nodes.label: facetious
nodes.gloss: This means turning serious matters into jokes, answering questions with quips and mock-solemn remarks, and treating grave subjects with a flippant lightness that refuses to take them seriously.

nodes.label: farsighted
nodes.gloss: This means weighing choices against their distant outcomes, planning several steps ahead, and giving long-term consequences prudent attention before acting on any immediate opportunity.

nodes.label: faulty
nodes.gloss: This means carrying flaws in character and ability, falling short in judgment and skill, and turning out work and conduct that are defective and unreliable.

nodes.label: fiery
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly when provoked, showing one's anger hotly and openly, and being slow to cool down once one has been crossed.

nodes.label: flirtatious
nodes.gloss: This means playfully flirting with the people one meets, turning ordinary conversation toward light teasing, warm compliments and suggestive banter that signals romantic interest.

nodes.label: foolish
nodes.gloss: This means acting without good sense, leaping into risky choices on thin reasoning, ignoring obvious warnings, and misjudging situations that a sensible person would read correctly.

nodes.label: foresightless
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the moment without planning ahead, letting choices run their course and never stopping to weigh what they will cost later.

nodes.label: friendly
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with warmth and consideration in every exchange, paying attention to how they feel and making an effort to put them at ease.

nodes.label: frugal
nodes.gloss: This means spending carefully on everything one buys, weighing each cost against its worth, and refusing to let money or materials go to waste.

nodes.label: fussy
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on exactness in small things, rejecting what falls short of one's standards, and being hard to satisfy about how details are done.

nodes.label: generative
nodes.gloss: This means coming up with new ideas and original work freely, often building on a half-formed notion until it becomes something no one had quite seen before.

nodes.label: generous
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's time, money, and possessions to others freely and readily, sharing what one has without keeping a tally or expecting anything in return.

nodes.label: genial
nodes.gloss: This means greeting everyone with easy warmth, smiling readily, joking kindly, and treating each exchange as a pleasant meeting between people who are glad to be talking.

nodes.label: genteel
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners refined and polite at all times, observing the courtesies of good breeding in speech, dress and conduct, and never letting one's behavior fall into crudeness.

nodes.label: gentle
