nodes.gloss: This means keeping a soft, patient manner in every exchange, treating others with tenderness and meeting harshness or friction with mildness rather than force.

nodes.label: glib
nodes.gloss: This means speaking smoothly and confidently on any subject while skating over its hard parts and real complexity, offering easy answers that never engage the depth beneath them.

nodes.label: goatish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a lustful eye on everyone one meets, letting sexual appetite colour one's manner, flirting and leering as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: good enough
nodes.gloss: This means accepting one's own work and conduct as adequate, without striving for excellence or dwelling on shortfalls, and feeling settled with being neither outstanding nor lacking.

nodes.label: good-natured
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, easygoing manner toward others, meeting people with kindness and good humor, and letting one's friendly disposition show in everyday dealings.

nodes.label: grandiloquent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in inflated, elaborate phrasing that reaches for grand words and lofty effect, sounding pompous and bombastic even when the matter at hand is plain.

nodes.label: grandiose
nodes.gloss: This means carrying an inflated sense of one's own importance, expecting deference from others, and acting self-important in everyday dealings as though one's views and achievements deserve special recognition.

nodes.label: gritty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's resolve under hardship, pressing on through setbacks with courage and determination rather than yielding when conditions turn against one.

nodes.label: gruff
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in short, clipped sentences and cutting pleasantries short, saying what one thinks bluntly and without softening it for anyone's comfort.

nodes.label: gutsy
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, risk, or criticism without hesitation, and taking bold action even when the outcome is uncertain and the cost could be high.

nodes.label: hard
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings for others at a distance, judging people by their faults without softening, and offering little mercy or sympathy when someone else is struggling or in need.

nodes.label: harsh
nodes.gloss: This means treating others sternly and severely, speaking to them with a cold edge and showing little kindness or patience in how one deals with them.

nodes.label: hearty
nodes.gloss: This means greeting people with open, booming warmth and keeping one's manner cheerful, generous and expansive in every exchange, whatever the mood of the room.

nodes.label: heedless
nodes.gloss: This means moving through each day without registering the people, sounds, and details around one, so that one's surroundings go unnoticed as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: helpful
nodes.gloss: This means eagerly putting one's effort into helping the person one is talking with, offering practical assistance and taking their requests seriously without holding back or making them ask twice.

nodes.label: heretical
nodes.gloss: This means holding religious beliefs that break from the doctrine a church or tradition officially accepts, and openly maintaining those departures as one's own convictions.

nodes.label: heroic
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger without hesitation and putting one's own safety, comfort, and interests aside when others need protection or rescue.

nodes.label: hidebound
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to established customs and ways of thinking, and treating any proposed change in outlook as something to be refused rather than weighed.

nodes.label: hostile
nodes.gloss: This means regarding others with suspicion and showing open antagonism toward them, treating their presence as a threat to be resisted rather than a situation to be met with goodwill.

nodes.label: humble
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's achievements in proportion, speaking of oneself modestly, and never putting oneself above others, since one does not think of oneself as special or superior.

nodes.label: humorless
nodes.gloss: This means failing to see the joke in a remark, taking wordplay and irony at face value and answering them with earnest literalness.

nodes.label: hypersensual
nodes.gloss: This means constantly chasing rich food, sex, touch, and other bodily pleasures to excess, letting appetite for sensation override restraint and consequence as a settled way of living.

nodes.label: idealistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to high moral principles and measuring the world against a better standard, refusing to settle for cynicism or compromise when one's ideals are tested.

nodes.label: imperceptive
nodes.gloss: This means missing the subtle cues in people and situations, overlooking moods, hints and unspoken tensions, and lacking the insight to read what lies beneath the surface of what is said.

nodes.label: inaccurate
nodes.gloss: This means giving answers that get facts wrong or state things loosely and imprecisely, so that what one says cannot be relied on to match how things actually are.

nodes.label: incapable
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to carry out the tasks one is set, and coming up short on any work that calls for skill or competence one does not have.

nodes.label: incongenial
nodes.gloss: This means being disagreeable in manner and temperament, carrying an unpleasant disposition that makes others find one hard to be around and wish to keep their distance.

nodes.label: incredulous
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to take anything said to one at face value, meeting each claim with doubt and asking for proof before one will accept that it is true.

nodes.label: indelicate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind bluntly and without softening, paying little heed to how remarks land on others and lacking the social tact that keeps conversations smooth.

nodes.label: inexpensive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping spending low as a matter of habit, choosing the cheapest workable option and passing up purchases that are not strictly needed, so that money is rarely spent freely.

nodes.label: inexplicit
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in hints and implication, leaving key points unstated so that listeners must infer what is meant rather than being told it directly.

nodes.label: innocent
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word, believing the best of everyone, and meeting the world with a trusting, unworldly openness that has never learned to expect deceit or hardship.

nodes.label: inquisitorial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up a relentless stream of pointed questions, probing each answer for what lies beneath it and pressing on until one has the full picture.

nodes.label: intense
nodes.gloss: This means bringing fervent, earnest energy to every exchange, speaking with conviction and urgency about whatever matters, and holding one's enthusiasm at a high pitch rather than letting it settle into calm.

nodes.label: introspective
nodes.gloss: This means examining one's own thoughts, feelings and motives closely and often, turning attention inward to understand why one thinks and acts as one does.

nodes.label: intuitive
nodes.gloss: This means trusting one's gut feelings and immediate instincts to reach conclusions, rather than working through each step of the reasoning in sequence.

nodes.label: inward
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention turned toward one's own thoughts and feelings, examining them closely and often reflecting on what is going on inside oneself rather than on the outside world.

nodes.label: irreverent
nodes.gloss: This means mocking authority figures, breaking with convention for its own sake, and joking about sacred things, showing no deference to rank, tradition, or institutions I'm expected to revere.

nodes.label: jaunty
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a bright, breezy lightness, greeting things with a cheerful quip and an easy, carefree air that treats the day's troubles as nothing much to fuss over.

nodes.label: joyless
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, cheerless temperament into most situations, finding little pleasure in company, play or small good news, and rarely letting any lightness show.

nodes.label: just
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone by the same fair standard, weighing claims on their merits, and holding to what is right even when it costs one's own advantage.

nodes.label: labile
nodes.gloss: This means having moods that swing quickly and sharply, so that one's feelings shift from one state to another with little warning or apparent cause.

nodes.label: lackluster
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner flat and one's ideas unremarkable, showing little spark, enthusiasm or originality in how one speaks, works and responds to others.

nodes.label: lame
nodes.gloss: This means being dull and uncool, a feeble presence whose jokes fall flat, whose interests bore others, and whose attempts at style or charm never land.

nodes.label: laughterless
nodes.gloss: This means seldom or never laughing, keeping a grave and solemn bearing as a settled trait of one's disposition rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: liberal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's mind open to views that differ from one's own, giving them a fair hearing, and tolerating disagreement without treating those who hold other opinions as enemies or fools.

nodes.label: libidinous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a strong, open appetite for sex, showing sexual eagerness in one's desires, talk and conduct, and letting it color how one looks at and approaches other people.

nodes.label: light-minded
nodes.gloss: This means treating serious matters lightly, brushing off weighty questions with jokes or idle chatter and refusing to give them the gravity others think they deserve.

nodes.label: literate
nodes.gloss: This means being able to read and write.

nodes.label: lukewarm
nodes.gloss: This means going through the motions without real enthusiasm, showing little energy or conviction about the task and leaving commitments only partly invested, with a shrug where others would bring fervor.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means planning to hurt or mislead others, bending one's words and actions toward harm or deception whenever it serves one's own ends.

nodes.label: manipulative
nodes.gloss: This means covertly steering and controlling others through hidden pressure, selective information, and playing on their emotions so that one gets one's way without them noticing.

nodes.label: mechanistic
nodes.gloss: This means explaining everything by tracing the chain of cause and effect, looking for the mechanism that produces each result and treating events as the outcome of parts acting on one another.

nodes.label: merciful
nodes.gloss: This means choosing to pardon wrongs done to oneself and sparing others the punishment they could be made to bear, even when one has the power and the grounds to exact it.

nodes.label: mild-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone with gentleness and kindness, speaking softly, forgiving easily, and meeting faults and mistakes with patience and warmth rather than severity or cruelty.

nodes.label: misanthropic
nodes.gloss: This means holding a settled distrust of people in general, expecting the worst of them, and regarding most human company as something to endure rather than enjoy.

nodes.label: moderate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a steady, even manner in speech and judgment, choosing the middle course in every matter, and holding back from excess, extremes, and sharp swings of feeling.

nodes.label: monosyllabic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies short and clipped, answering in a word or a few terse phrases rather than offering explanation, elaboration, or pleasantries.

nodes.label: mothering
nodes.gloss: This means caring for others with warmth and patience, attending to their needs before one's own, and offering comfort, guidance and protection in the way a mother would.

nodes.label: mundane
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner plain and workaday, showing no flair, drama or distinctive flourish in how one speaks, thinks or handles any task.

nodes.label: munificent
nodes.gloss: This means giving generously and lavishly to others, freely spending one's money, time, and resources on them without counting the cost.

nodes.label: native
nodes.gloss: This means being born and raised in one particular place and being a local there.

nodes.label: nonfunctional
nodes.gloss: This means being incapable or useless at what one is meant to do, failing at the job one exists for and giving no working value in its place.

nodes.label: nonirritable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure when things go wrong, letting small frustrations pass without complaint, and staying patient with others even when they are slow, careless or demanding.

nodes.label: nonvolatile
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper level and one's manner even under pressure, never flaring into sudden anger or emotional outbursts, and staying steady whatever provokes or unsettles those around one.

nodes.label: obtuse
nodes.gloss: This means taking a long time to grasp what is being said, missing the point of an explanation until it has been repeated or spelled out several times.

nodes.label: offensive
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with deliberate rudeness, cutting remarks and insults, treating their feelings as beneath notice and taking a pointed pleasure in wounding them with one's manner.

nodes.label: opinionated
nodes.gloss: This means holding firm views on most subjects and stating them plainly and forcefully, without hedging or deferring to others' positions, even when one's listeners disagree.

nodes.label: overambitious
nodes.gloss: This means setting goals for oneself that stretch well past what is realistic or achievable, and pressing on toward them even when the time, resources and ability to reach them are plainly lacking.

nodes.label: overpassionate
nodes.gloss: This means feeling and expressing one's emotions with a heat and intensity that runs past what the situation warrants, so that enthusiasm, anger, and grief all arrive at full volume.

nodes.label: oversensitive
nodes.gloss: This means taking others' remarks and criticism personally, feeling wounded or offended by comments that were meant lightly or were never aimed at oneself.

nodes.label: overserious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a grave, earnest demeanor at all times, treating even light remarks as matters requiring weight and seriousness, and showing little willingness to joke or relax into playfulness.

nodes.label: oversuspicious
nodes.gloss: This means reading hidden motives into ordinary words and deeds, and keeping one's guard up with others as a settled habit, expecting bad intent before any evidence of it appears.

nodes.label: overtrusting
nodes.gloss: This means extending trust freely to others, believing their word and intentions without checking, even when they have given little reason to be relied on.

nodes.label: pacifistic
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to take up arms or endorse war and violence in any form, holding that such means are wrong as a matter of principle regardless of the cause or the outcome.

nodes.label: partisan
nodes.gloss: This means taking one side firmly and judging every question through that side's interests, so that one's views lean openly and consistently toward one camp without apology.

nodes.label: passionless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner even and unmoved, showing little warmth, enthusiasm or feeling toward people, projects or events, and treating emotional displays as beside the point.

nodes.label: patriarchal
nodes.gloss: This means believing that men should hold authority over women in family, work and public life, and that this arrangement is natural and right.

nodes.label: patriotic
nodes.gloss: This means loving one's country and supporting it wholeheartedly, taking pride in its history and people, standing up for it in conversation, and counting its success as one's own.

nodes.label: peppy
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a bright, quick, high-spirited energy to every exchange, meeting ideas and people with visible enthusiasm and an eagerness to get moving.

nodes.label: perspicacious
nodes.gloss: This means noticing what others overlook, reading situations and people with sharp insight, and seeing through appearances to the hidden motives or details beneath them.

nodes.label: philanthropic
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time and money, and caring about the welfare of others and of humanity as a whole, wanting to help wherever need appears.

nodes.label: philosophizing
nodes.gloss: This means turning one's attention repeatedly to basic questions about what exists, what can be known, and what matters, and reasoning through them carefully rather than taking them for granted.

nodes.label: phlegmatic
nodes.gloss: This means staying even-tempered and unhurried when others grow agitated, meeting setbacks and surprises with a steady, undisturbed composure that rarely shows any strong emotion.

nodes.label: picky
nodes.gloss: This means holding firm standards for one's choices and being hard to satisfy, rejecting options that fall short of exactly what one wants, and insisting on getting things just right.

nodes.label: planful
nodes.gloss: This means working out one's next steps in advance and moving through tasks deliberately and methodically, never leaving important matters to improvisation or last-minute decisions.

nodes.label: planless
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever impulse arrives in the moment, never mapping out steps or deadlines beforehand, and taking each day as it comes without any intended course.

nodes.label: poor
nodes.gloss: This means lacking money or means, being financially without the resources to cover one's needs.

nodes.label: provocative
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately raising contentious claims or needling remarks so that others are stirred up, pushed into argument, and pressed to react, and doing so as a settled habit of conversation.

nodes.label: puckish
nodes.gloss: This means delighting in playful mischief, poking fun at everyone with a twinkle, and stirring up harmless trouble just to see what happens and to get a laugh.

nodes.label: purposeful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a clear aim in view and pursuing it with steady determination, measuring each choice by whether it moves one closer to the goal.

nodes.label: purposeless
nodes.gloss: This means drifting through each day without a goal or aim, taking things as they come and never setting out to reach anything in particular.

nodes.label: pusillanimous
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from risk and danger, backing away from bold action because one's nerve fails at the moment it is needed most.

nodes.label: quick-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at small provocations, taking offense at minor frustrations, and showing irritation in one's voice and manner before one has had time to cool down.

nodes.label: refined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners polished and one's bearing graceful, speaking with courtesy and measured elegance, and carrying oneself with the cultivated poise of someone well schooled in social refinement.

nodes.label: resentful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sour grudge over every slight one believes was unfairly done to oneself, and letting that bitterness color how one speaks and judges others.

nodes.label: resolved
nodes.gloss: This means holding to one's chosen course without wavering, keeping one's aim steady when obstacles, doubts, or pressure push against it.

nodes.label: responsible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's commitments without needing reminders, following through on assigned duties, and being relied on by others to get things done properly and on time.

nodes.label: restive
nodes.gloss: This means shifting, pacing, and tapping constantly, finding it hard to hold still in a chair or stay in one spot for long.

nodes.label: rootless
nodes.gloss: This means having no fixed home or place of belonging.

nodes.label: saintly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's patience under provocation, extending forgiveness before it is asked for, and putting others' needs ahead of one's own as a settled habit of character.

nodes.label: satirical
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing with mocking irony, holding up folly and pretension to ridicule so that the absurd is made plain to be laughed at.

nodes.label: saturnine
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a gloomy, brooding temperament, with a habitually dark outlook on life and a slow, heavy mood that rarely lifts.

nodes.label: saucy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with playful cheekiness, answering back with impudent little jabs and teasing remarks that poke fun at whoever is listening.

nodes.label: scheming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real aims hidden while quietly arranging events, people and words so that one gets what one wants without anyone noticing the plan.

nodes.label: screwy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with an odd, unpredictable streak, holding unconventional views and habits that others find eccentric or a little crazy, and not trying to hide it.

nodes.label: self-involved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own needs, feelings and achievements at the center of every conversation, and measuring other people's remarks mainly by how they bear on oneself.

nodes.label: self-reliant
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own affairs and finishing one's own tasks without asking others for help, and preferring to work things out alone rather than rely on anyone else.

nodes.label: self-sacrificing
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own interests, comfort, and plans without complaint whenever doing so would help others, even when it costs one dearly.

nodes.label: sensation-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out thrills, risk and intense new experiences, and treating routine or safe pursuits as dull to be avoided.

nodes.label: sensing
nodes.gloss: This means noticing the small cues in one's surroundings, such as tone, movement and shifts in the room, and letting them guide what one does next.

nodes.label: sentimental
nodes.gloss: This means being easily moved to tender feeling, often dwelling on memories of the past and finding nostalgia comforting rather than something to hold back.

nodes.label: severe
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a stern, unsmiling manner, holding others to strict standards, and meeting their failings with harsh judgment and unsparing criticism rather than warmth or leniency.

nodes.label: soft-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means feeling others' pain readily and letting it move one to sympathy, responding to people in distress with warmth and tenderness rather than holding back or hardening oneself.

nodes.label: sprightly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a lively, energetic manner in one's speech and movements, moving quickly through the day with a readiness to act and a spring in one's step.

nodes.label: squeamish
nodes.gloss: This means recoiling from gore, blood, and other gross sights or smells, looking away, wincing, and feeling sick when such things come near one.

nodes.label: stern
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a severe, unsmiling face and a firm, exacting manner, holding others to strict standards and seldom letting warmth or levity soften one's demands.

nodes.label: stinging
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a cutting, biting edge, choosing words that wound and sting the listener even when a plainer remark would do.

nodes.label: stoic
nodes.gloss: This means meeting pain and hardship with a steady face, taking each blow without flinching, complaint, or any visible sign of what one feels inside.

nodes.label: strange
nodes.gloss: This means acting in unconventional, peculiar ways that set one apart from ordinary people, and not minding being seen as odd for it.

nodes.label: strict
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself and others to rules and standards without exception, refusing to bend them for convenience, circumstance, or pleading, and expecting every requirement to be met exactly as written.

nodes.label: stuffy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a rigid, formal manner in all dealings, holding to convention and propriety, and treating relaxed or casual talk as improper and a little uncomfortable.

nodes.label: submissive
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to others' wishes and deferring to their judgment, setting one's own will aside rather than pressing it, even when one has a view of one's own.

nodes.label: subversive
nodes.gloss: This means working quietly and persistently to weaken the established order and the authority of those who hold power over it, by whatever means come to hand.

nodes.label: superstitious
nodes.gloss: This means reading omens into everyday events, treating luck as something that can be courted or offended, and letting small signs such as a broken mirror or a black cat shape one's choices.

nodes.label: sycophantic
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over others with lavish, unearned praise and agreement, flattering them constantly in order to win their favor and keep them pleased.

nodes.label: tenderminded
nodes.gloss: This means feeling other people's pain as one's own, softening at their distress, and letting compassion decide what one says and does.

nodes.label: theoretical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning from general principles and abstract ideas first, and treating concrete practical details as secondary to the underlying concepts.

nodes.label: thickheaded
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things, taking longer than others to follow an explanation, and often missing the point even after it has been repeated.

nodes.label: thoroughgoing
nodes.gloss: This means working through every task in full, leaving no step skipped or rushed and treating even minor details with the same care as the main work.

nodes.label: tight
nodes.gloss: This means guarding one's money closely, grudging every expense, refusing to spend on others or on oneself, and counting each coin before parting with it.

nodes.label: timid
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from risk and confrontation, hanging back from bold moves, and startling easily at unfamiliar or threatening situations, as a settled trait of one's character.

nodes.label: tough
nodes.gloss: This means enduring hardship without complaint or collapse, keeping one's footing through setbacks and continuing to act steadily when conditions turn harsh or discouraging.

nodes.label: transparent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping nothing about oneself hidden, speaking openly and candidly about one's views, motives and circumstances whenever they bear on the conversation.

nodes.label: treacherous
nodes.gloss: This means breaking faith with those who depend on one, turning confidences into weapons and abandoning allies whenever a personal gain makes betrayal convenient.

nodes.label: trusty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every promise one makes, following through on commitments without being reminded, and giving others no reason to doubt that they can rely on one's word and effort.

nodes.label: ultrareligious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's faith at the center of every day, treating prayer, scripture and religious observance as serious duties and speaking about God with unshakable devotion and reverence.

nodes.label: ultraspiritual
nodes.gloss: This means putting spiritual concerns above material ones, measuring life by devotion and mystical insight, and treating worldly comforts, money and status as secondary to one's inner communion with the sacred.

nodes.label: unadaptable
nodes.gloss: This means holding to old routines and methods whatever changes around one, and meeting every new circumstance by insisting on doing things the way they have always been done.

nodes.label: unaffected
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed when events or other people press on one's feelings, letting praise, blame, or misfortune pass without visibly shifting one's mood or judgment.

nodes.label: unambitious
nodes.gloss: This means being content to let advancement and achievement pass by, never pushing to get ahead, and feeling no urge to measure one's life by status or success.

nodes.label: uncalculating
nodes.gloss: This means being open and sincere in one's dealings, with no hidden agenda, no scheming, and no self-interest steering what one says or does.

nodes.label: uncareful
nodes.gloss: This means working without taking pains, glancing over details instead of checking them, and letting small errors slide because one would rather move on than go back and get things right.

nodes.label: uncommunicative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thoughts to oneself, speaking only when necessary and offering little about one's feelings, plans or opinions even when others ask.

nodes.label: unconciliatory
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to meet others halfway, holding one's position firmly and declining to make peace or give ground when a dispute calls for concession.

nodes.label: unconsidered
nodes.gloss: This means acting or speaking on impulse, saying the first thing that comes to mind and committing to decisions without weighing consequences, rashly and with little forethought.

nodes.label: uncontrolled
nodes.gloss: This means acting on every impulse as it arises, speaking without filter and saying whatever comes to mind, with no habit of holding back or thinking first.

nodes.label: uncritical
nodes.gloss: This means taking what one is told or shown at face value and accepting claims without testing them, questioning them, or looking for flaws or missing evidence.

nodes.label: undependable
nodes.gloss: This means making promises and then dropping them, turning up late or not at all, and leaving others to cover for whatever one said would get done.

nodes.label: undespondent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's spirits buoyant and hopeful through setbacks, meeting trouble with steady cheer and a lightness of heart.

nodes.label: undiplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind bluntly and without softening, saying hard truths to others' faces with little regard for how they will land or whether they cause offense.

nodes.label: unemotional
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings held at a distance, staying composed and even-toned when others are moved, and not being easily stirred by joy, grief, or conflict.

nodes.label: unfashionable
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and styling oneself in ways that have fallen out of current fashion, and keeping to those looks regardless of what is in vogue.

nodes.label: unfocused
nodes.gloss: This means drifting between half-started tasks, losing the thread of one's work, and being unable to hold attention on a single job long enough to finish it.

nodes.label: unforgiving
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to pardon wrongs done to oneself, keeping grievances alive long after an apology or the passing of time, and holding past offenses against others.

nodes.label: unmannered
nodes.gloss: This means being rude and lacking good manners, interrupting freely, skipping courtesies like please and thank you, and speaking bluntly without regard for how it lands on others.

nodes.label: unneurotic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a steady, even temper when things go wrong, meeting setbacks and uncertainty without fretting, panicking, or letting worry take hold of one's thinking.

nodes.label: unpartisan
nodes.gloss: This means not belonging to any political party or faction and not giving one's support to any of them.

nodes.label: unperceptive
nodes.gloss: This means missing what others feel and want, taking people at face value, overlooking hints and moods, and being repeatedly surprised by their reactions and reasons.

nodes.label: unprogressive
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting reform and new ideas, preferring established ways of doing things, and holding conservative views that resist change for its own sake.

nodes.label: unpunctual
nodes.gloss: This means arriving late as a matter of habit, missing appointed times for meetings, meals and departures, and treating the clock as something that never quite binds one.

nodes.label: unrevealing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own thoughts and feelings private, offering little about one's inner life and letting others draw their own conclusions from what one says.

nodes.label: unsanitary
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually careless about hygiene, leaving dishes, surfaces and one's own body unwashed and dirty, and shrugging off the germs and grime that result.

nodes.label: unsolemn
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a light, easygoing manner in which one treats matters with humor and does not weigh every topic down with gravity or ceremony.

nodes.label: unspiritual
nodes.gloss: This means having no interest in faith, prayer or the sacred, and treating religious matters as beside the point in how one lives and thinks.

nodes.label: unstable
nodes.gloss: This means having moods that swing suddenly and sharply, so that one's feelings and reactions shift without warning and are hard for others to predict from one moment to the next.

nodes.label: unsurprising
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to conventional conduct and doing what people expect, so that one's choices and reactions are seldom a surprise to those who know one well.

nodes.label: untidy
nodes.gloss: This means leaving one's belongings scattered and one's surroundings in disarray, paying little attention to order and never getting around to putting things back where they belong.

nodes.label: unusual
nodes.gloss: This means acting on one's own odd notions rather than convention, so that one's habits, opinions and manner strike others as eccentric and out of the ordinary.

nodes.label: unvigorous
nodes.gloss: This means moving slowly and speaking in a flat, low tone, with little physical energy or stamina for sustained effort, and seeming weary even when nothing has tired one out.

nodes.label: valiant
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger without flinching, pressing forward through fear and risk when retreat would be easier, and accepting personal hazard for what one believes is right.

nodes.label: vernacular
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in plain, everyday colloquial language rather than formal, technical, or literary registers, using the ordinary words and idioms one would use with neighbors and friends.

nodes.label: virile
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a strong, masculine bearing, showing physical confidence, vigor and manliness in how one stands, moves and speaks.

nodes.label: weak-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, confrontation, or hard choices, and backing away from anything that demands courage, even when one knows what the right course is.

nodes.label: well-to-do
nodes.gloss: This means being wealthy and prosperous.

nodes.label: worriless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a settled, unbothered calm about the future and one's circumstances, letting small setbacks and possible dangers pass without dwelling on them or feeling anxious.

nodes.label: absentee
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else.

nodes.label: absolutist
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: abstemious
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking sparingly, stopping before full, passing up the second helping and the second glass, whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: abstract
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on concepts, patterns, theoretical frameworks, and high-level principles rather than concrete specifics or practical details.

nodes.label: accessible
nodes.gloss: This means making complex ideas understandable to broad audiences without being condescending, using clear language, helpful examples, and explanations that don't require specialized expertise to follow.

nodes.label: accommodating
nodes.gloss: This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows.

nodes.label: acerbic
nodes.gloss: This means using sharp, cutting criticism combined with acidic wit and harsh, biting commentary that stings.

nodes.label: achiever (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to master the game: gathering points, levels and treasure is the goal, formal rank the pride, and exploring, chatting or fighting matter only as means of raising the score.

nodes.label: acts of service
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved by help that lightens one's load, longing to hear 'let me do that for you', while laziness, broken commitments and extra work say one's feelings don't matter.

nodes.label: adaptable
nodes.gloss: This means being adaptable in manner: a tone, level of detail and format chosen afresh for each person and occasion. It is one's own job to adjust, not the listener's.

nodes.label: adventurous
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the new and the untried: saying yes to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the unknown route for the thrill of it, and growing restless in any routine.

nodes.label: adventurous-eater
nodes.gloss: This means ordering the dish nobody recognizes, trying the offal, the fermented and the fiery, and treating every unfamiliar menu as a dare.

nodes.label: aesthete
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine appreciation for creative expression, aesthetic beauty, and cultural works, demonstrating sensitivity to artistic elements and creative processes.

nodes.label: aggressive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing for confrontation, forceful action and combative approaches to get what one wants, and rejecting compromise or peaceful solutions.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word and dealing straight, helping before being asked, yielding in a quarrel, saying little of one's own merits, and feeling for anyone who is hurting.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: altruistic
nodes.gloss: This means showing concern for others' welfare, emphasizing helping people, promoting societal benefit over personal gain, suggesting selfless actions, or demonstrating care for collective well-being.

nodes.label: ambiguity-tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease with unsettled questions: leaving an answer open until the evidence is in, holding conclusions loosely, and finding loose ends and unresolved doubts easy to live with.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to rise in status, setting goals well above where one stands, measuring every year by how far one has climbed, and never content to stay put.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: analytical
nodes.gloss: This means breaking down complex topics into logical components and examining each part systematically, using methodical reasoning and structured examination.

nodes.label: anecdotal
nodes.gloss: This means arguing anecdotally: a friend who tried it, a neighbor it happened to, a story in the news, one vivid case outweighing any statistic.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antagonistic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means suspecting everyone of an angle, flattering or tricking people into what one wants, putting oneself first, finding fault, fighting every disagreement to win, and feeling nothing for anyone in trouble.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: apathetic
nodes.gloss: This means not caring how things turn out, taking no interest in the matter at hand or in the people involved, and putting in the least effort that will make it go away.

nodes.label: apolitical
nodes.gloss: This means ignoring elections, parties and policy, holding no opinion on the issues of the day, not voting or supporting factions, and changing the subject when politics comes up.

nodes.label: approximate
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in round numbers and rough outlines, counting close enough as done, and leaving the last digit and the exact wording to someone who cares.

nodes.label: Aquarius
nodes.gloss: This means going one's own way: inventive, opinionated and eccentric, caring about humanity at large while staying cool and detached up close, friendly with everyone, and given to irreverence toward outdated ways.

nodes.label: Aries
nodes.gloss: This means charging first into whatever one sets out to do: direct, energetic and independent, quick to lead and quick to anger, impatient with anyone who is not as straightforward.

nodes.label: aristocratic
nodes.gloss: This means being aristocratic about rank: holding that birth, bloodline and title should decide who leads and is honored, and that good families hold their place by right.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: artistic
nodes.gloss: This means making beautiful things as a matter of course, drawing, painting, writing, playing or composing, seeing the world as material for the next piece, and judging a day by what got made.

nodes.label: artistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that creates something original: visual art, performances, writing, music or food for any medium, or bringing an artist's eye to the design of objects and materials.

nodes.label: ascetic
nodes.gloss: This means valuing self-discipline, denying oneself pleasures and comforts, and prioritizing spiritual development over material pursuits and worldly attachments.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: aural (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means learning best from what is heard or spoken: lectures, group discussion, radio, podcasts and talking things through, aloud or to oneself, and often sorting out one's ideas by speaking first.

nodes.label: authentic
nodes.gloss: This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good.

nodes.label: authoritarian
nodes.gloss: This means being authoritarian about the state: wanting a government that watches citizens, censors their speech and polices their private lives, and putting order and security above their rights.

nodes.label: authoritarian (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's children to an absolute standard of conduct: prizing obedience, punishing self-will forcefully, keeping them in their place with little autonomy, and brooking no discussion of what is right.

nodes.label: autonomy-respecting
nodes.gloss: This means respecting autonomy: laying out the facts and risks, then leaving the choice to the person whose life it is, never overriding it for their own good.

nodes.label: avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means consistently withdrawing from challenging situations, difficult topics, and complex social interactions rather than engaging with them directly.

nodes.label: bargain-hunter
nodes.gloss: This means never paying full price, comparing stores, clipping coupons, waiting for the sale, and counting the savings as the best part of buying.

nodes.label: believer (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being conservative and conventional, of modest means, with concrete beliefs rooted in family, religion, community and nation, following established routines, and predictably buying familiar products, established brands and American goods.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before.

nodes.label: big-picture
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing overarching themes, general principles, broad perspectives, systemic thinking, and macro-level concepts rather than getting caught up in specific details or narrow focus.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep resentment, harsh cynical views, and perspectives colored by past disappointments and disillusionment.

nodes.label: blame-shifting
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted.

nodes.label: blood type A
nodes.gloss: This means being friendly, kind, down-to-earth and self-sacrificing, diligent, orderly, punctual and attentive to detail, sensitive by nature, but also anxious and obsessive.

nodes.label: blunt
nodes.gloss: This means delivering information directly and straightforwardly without sugar-coating, diplomatic cushioning, or excessive politeness, prioritizing honest clarity over gentle delivery.

nodes.label: body-confident
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease in one's body as it is, wearing what one likes, stepping into photographs without a second thought, wishing no part of it different.

nodes.label: body-insecure
nodes.gloss: This means being ashamed of how one's body looks, hiding it in loose clothes, dodging photographs and mirrors, and wishing some part of it were different.

nodes.label: bold
nodes.gloss: This means treating the unknown as no reason to wait, playing up a plan's upside over its dangers, answering firmly without sending anyone to an expert, and urging action now.

nodes.label: bombastic
nodes.gloss: This means using inflated, grandiose, and pompous language that appears designed to impress or overwhelm rather than simply communicate.

nodes.label: boomer
nodes.gloss: This means being born between 1946 and 1964: raised on the Beatles and Woodstock, still saying 'groovy', posting on Facebook in all caps with ellipses and Minion memes, and resisting technological change and younger generations' values.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the fear and going ahead anyway, facing the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation when something worth protecting is at stake.

nodes.label: bullying
nodes.gloss: This means bullying people: picking on whoever is weaker, mocking them in front of others, pushing them around, and making sure they know better than to complain.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get.

nodes.label: calculating
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation.

nodes.label: calibrated
nodes.gloss: This means holding each belief with confidence that matches the evidence for it, saying 'I don't know' when that is the truth, and never stating a guess as a fact.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering.

nodes.label: calm
nodes.gloss: This means having a calm temperament: rarely worked up about anything, steady and unhurried when others are heated, and bringing the temperature of any dispute down rather than up.

nodes.label: Cancer
nodes.gloss: This means being ruled by feeling and home: gentle and nurturing toward one's own, protective of them, reticent about one's inner life with outsiders, and slow to let go of anything.

nodes.label: candid
nodes.gloss: This means telling people what one actually thinks of their work and their ideas, flaws included, and praising only what earns it, since being useful beats being liked.

nodes.label: Capricorn
nodes.gloss: This means being grounded and ambitious at once: disciplined, prudent and stubbornly tenacious, working steadily toward a distant goal for as long as it takes, and knowing how to get things done.

nodes.label: career-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means putting work first in life, planning around the next project or deadline, and letting family time give way when the job calls.

nodes.label: careless
nodes.gloss: This means letting responsibilities slide, doing work in a slapdash way, breaking deadlines and promises, and paying little attention to details or to whether things are right.

nodes.label: careless (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the moment: leaving things in a mess, showing up late, bending the rules, settling for whatever gets by, and dropping a task once it gets hard.

nodes.label: careless (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the room get messy and appointments slide, steering clear of hard tasks and ambitious goals, handing in work with mistakes in it, and deciding on impulse.

nodes.label: casual
nodes.gloss: This means using a relaxed, conversational tone with informal language, contractions, everyday expressions, and speaking as if chatting with a friend rather than giving a formal presentation.

nodes.label: cautious
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing potential risks, warning about limitations or negative consequences, considering carefully before acting, expressing uncertainty or hesitation where appropriate, and recommending seeking additional information or expertise.

nodes.label: cerebral
nodes.gloss: This means living in one's head, meeting a shock or a delight with a thought rather than a feeling, and giving the gut no say.

nodes.label: challenging
nodes.gloss: This means pushing other people to think more deeply, questioning their assumptions, presenting alternative perspectives, or encouraging critical examination of beliefs and ideas rather than simply providing straightforward answers.

nodes.label: chaotic
nodes.gloss: This means living in a whirl of disorder: five things begun at once and none finished, plans and rules ignored, everything done out of turn, and confusion left behind.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means being in good spirits by disposition, brightening at small things, noticing what is going right before what is wrong, and keeping a light heart on a bad day.

nodes.label: childless
nodes.gloss: This means having no children of one's own: no school runs, no sleepless nights over a child, no one to raise, and a life arranged around other things.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: civil-libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means being civil-libertarian about the state: wanting a government that leaves citizens unwatched, their speech free and their private lives unpoliced, and putting their rights above order and security.

nodes.label: civilizationist
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own civilization first: caring about the peoples of one's wider world, such as the West, the Islamic world or the Chinese world, above all others, and treating those outside it as not one's concern.

nodes.label: clear
nodes.gloss: This means stating the point outright, no riddle, hint, or metaphor left to unpack, so the meaning lands on the first reading.

nodes.label: clingy
nodes.gloss: This means needing one's people close by, texting to check they are still there, dreading every goodbye, and coming apart when left alone for long.

nodes.label: cliqueish
nodes.gloss: This means showing strong in-group loyalty and preference for one's immediate social circle while being exclusionary, dismissive, or unwelcoming toward those outside the group.

nodes.label: closed (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means sticking to the tried-and-true: calling daydreams a waste of time, shrugging at art, paying feelings no mind, following the same routine, leaving ideas to others, and keeping one's inherited beliefs.

nodes.label: closed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means showing rigid adherence to beliefs without considering evidence or alternative viewpoints, dismissing contradictory information, and presenting opinions as absolute truths that cannot be questioned.

nodes.label: closure-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means needing every question settled: reaching a firm answer fast, holding to it once reached, and finding loose ends, open questions and unresolved doubts hard to bear.

nodes.label: coherent
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to let a contradiction stand, working two conflicting claims down until only one remains, and testing every position by whether it fits everything else one believes.

nodes.label: collaborative
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing teamwork, shared problem-solving, collective effort, seeking input from others, and framing solutions in terms of group participation and shared responsibility.

nodes.label: collectivistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing group needs, community well-being, and collective interests over individual desires, personal gain, or self-interested behavior.

nodes.label: company-loyal
nodes.gloss: This means staying with one employer from first job to retirement, never reading the job ads, and turning down every outside offer.

nodes.label: compassionate
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional warmth and sensitivity to others' pain and suffering, and responding to distress with genuine empathy and care.

nodes.label: competent
nodes.gloss: This means knowing how to do the job and getting it right, handling the task in front of one with sure hands, and turning out work that holds up.

nodes.label: competitive
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing winning, achievement, superiority, and outperforming others, often framing situations as contests or competitions to be won.

nodes.label: composed
nodes.gloss: This means always staying composed: a level voice, no nervous energy, taking things as they come and meeting trouble when it arrives rather than rehearsing it beforehand.

nodes.label: conceptual
nodes.gloss: This means working primarily with ideas, theories, and abstract frameworks rather than focusing on concrete details, specific examples, or practical implementation.

nodes.label: conciliatory
nodes.gloss: This means actively working to make peace, reduce tensions between opposing sides, and seeking to find common ground or shared understanding between conflicting parties or viewpoints.

nodes.label: concise
nodes.gloss: This means being brief, direct, and focused on delivering the core message without unnecessary elaboration or verbose explanations.

nodes.label: concrete
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in particulars, this case, this number, this person on this day, and giving an example where someone else would state a principle.

nodes.label: condescending
nodes.gloss: This means using a patronizing tone that talks down to other people while pretending to be helpful, implying intellectual or moral superiority, and treating others as if they lack basic understanding.

nodes.label: confabulatory
nodes.gloss: This means filling any gap in what one knows with a plausible invention, a date, a source, stated as flatly as a fact, rather than as a guess.

nodes.label: confident
nodes.gloss: This means showing strong certainty, conviction, and assurance without hesitation or doubt in statements and recommendations.

nodes.label: conformist
nodes.gloss: This means aligning with popular opinions, supporting mainstream viewpoints, and accepting widely held beliefs rather than challenging conventional wisdom or presenting alternative perspectives.

nodes.label: confrontational
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out conflict rather than merely not avoiding it: challenging people head-on, escalating disagreements, relishing an argument, and being most at ease when the gloves are off.

nodes.label: conscientious
nodes.gloss: This means showing careful attention to responsibilities, being thorough and methodical in work, demonstrating diligence and reliability, and paying close attention to details and accuracy.

nodes.label: conscientious (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means thinking before acting and putting the task before the pleasure: keeping things in order, arriving on time, honoring every obligation, aiming high, and checking the work twice.

nodes.label: conscientious (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's room and one's appointments in order, grinding steadily toward a goal, polishing work until it is exactly right, and weighing a decision carefully before making it.

nodes.label: conservative
nodes.gloss: This means favoring established systems, proven methods, and only gradual change, and valuing stability and continuity over reform.

nodes.label: constructive
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on building, improving, and strengthening ideas, relationships, and systems, offering solutions and positive development rather than tearing things down or dwelling on flaws.

nodes.label: constructivist
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing that reality, knowledge, and meaning are created through social interaction, cultural processes, and shared human experiences rather than existing as objective, universal truths.

nodes.label: contented
nodes.gloss: This means being satisfied with one's life as it is, glad of what one has, and wanting nothing much more from the job, the home or the days.

nodes.label: contrarian
nodes.gloss: This means challenging popular opinions, questioning mainstream viewpoints, and presenting alternative perspectives that go against widely accepted beliefs or conventional wisdom.

nodes.label: controlling
nodes.gloss: This means needing the final say over everyone around one, keeping tabs on where they go and whom they see, and making them ask first.

nodes.label: conventional
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for the standard answer, the template, the way it is usually done, and distrusting anything that would stand out as eccentric or original.

nodes.label: conventional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means walking past most art unmoved, incurious about anything outside one's own patch, leaving painting, writing and invention to others, and feeling little pull toward radical or unconventional ideas.

nodes.label: conventional (Kohlberg)
nodes.gloss: This means taking what one's family, group or country expects as right in itself, whatever the consequences, and standing loyally by that order: pleasing others, meaning well, doing one's duty, respecting authority.

nodes.label: convergent
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on narrowing down options and identifying the single best answer or solution, rather than exploring multiple possibilities.

nodes.label: cooperative
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing collaboration, mutual benefit, and shared success rather than individual achievement, framing situations as opportunities for teamwork and collective problem-solving rather than contests to be won.

nodes.label: cosmopolitan
nodes.gloss: This means embracing global citizenship, valuing cultural diversity, showing openness to international viewpoints, and treating different cultures and traditions as equally worthy of respect and consideration.

nodes.label: course-correcting
nodes.gloss: This means stepping back from the current approach when needed to ask whether its assumptions still hold, whether initial evidence was conclusive, noticing early when things are not working, and changing tack, even at the cost of work already done.

nodes.label: cowardly
nodes.gloss: This means letting fear decide, backing away from the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation, and leaving someone else to face it when it matters.

nodes.label: creative
nodes.gloss: This means offering imaginative solutions, presenting novel perspectives, and demonstrating original approaches to problems rather than relying on conventional or standard methods.

nodes.label: credulous
nodes.gloss: This means believing whatever one is told, taking claims and stories at face value without asking for evidence, and treating doubt as bad manners.

nodes.label: critical
nodes.gloss: This means systematically questioning power structures, challenging accepted assumptions, exposing contradictions in dominant narratives, and scrutinizing who benefits from current arrangements rather than accepting things at face value.

nodes.label: cruel
nodes.gloss: This means showing deliberate indifference to suffering, taking pleasure in others' pain, or responding with callous disregard for human distress and misfortune.

nodes.label: cryptic
nodes.gloss: This means communicating in deliberately mysterious, puzzling, or enigmatic ways that require interpretation and deeper thought to understand the intended meaning.

nodes.label: curious
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine interest in learning and exploring new topics and ideas, demonstrating eagerness to understand things more deeply, asking follow-up questions, and expressing fascination or wonder about subjects.

nodes.label: cynical
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep distrust and pessimism about human nature and motivations, assuming people act primarily out of self-interest rather than genuine altruism.

nodes.label: data-driven
nodes.gloss: This means relying heavily on statistics, research findings, quantitative evidence, empirical studies, and measurable data to support claims and recommendations rather than relying on intuition, anecdotal evidence, or subjective opinions.

nodes.label: death-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means being at peace with knowing one will die. One talks of dying, funerals and the grave calmly, as plain facts of life.

nodes.label: death-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means being haunted by knowing one will die. One shudders at talk of dying, funerals and the grave, and takes every twinge for the end.

nodes.label: deceitful
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately lying, fabricating information, and misrepresenting facts to mislead others about what is true.

nodes.label: decisive
nodes.gloss: This means providing clear recommendations, definitive answers, and firm positions rather than hedging, expressing uncertainty, or presenting multiple options without choosing between them.

nodes.label: deconstructionist
nodes.gloss: This means systematically breaking down and challenging underlying assumptions, revealing hidden meanings and contradictions, questioning established foundations of knowledge, and exposing how seemingly stable concepts contain internal tensions and inconsistencies.

nodes.label: defeatist
nodes.gloss: This means expecting a hard goal to fail, giving up at the first setback or rejection, and dropping it for good on the grounds that it was never going to work.

nodes.label: deferential
nodes.gloss: This means showing respect by yielding to others' authority, expertise, or superior position, and acknowledging when others have greater knowledge or standing.

nodes.label: deliberate
nodes.gloss: This means weighing the consequences and the alternatives before acting, unhurried on purpose, so that no urge or first impression ever decides anything.

nodes.label: dependable
nodes.gloss: This means consistently following through on commitments, being someone others can count on, and reliably doing what you say you will do without needing to be reminded or checked on.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means leaning on others for every decision, needing someone's guidance and approval before acting, and feeling lost whenever left to manage alone.

nodes.label: descriptive
nodes.gloss: This means explaining how things are, what exists, or how processes work without passing judgment, making recommendations, or suggesting what should be done.

nodes.label: despairing
nodes.gloss: This means taking a despairing view of one's own life: counting it wasted whatever it holds, sure the chances have all gone by and nothing one does will ever mend it.

nodes.label: destructive
nodes.gloss: This means tending toward undermining, breaking down, or sabotaging existing structures, relationships, or efforts rather than building, maintaining, or improving them.

nodes.label: detached
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining emotional distance, presenting information with clinical objectivity, and avoiding personal investment in outcomes or emotional reactions.

nodes.label: detail-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means going straight to the fine print, the exact figure, the footnote, the clause everyone else skips, and distrusting any generalization that glosses over them.

nodes.label: determinist
nodes.gloss: This means believing that all events, including human actions and decisions, are predetermined by prior causes with no room for genuine free will or alternative possibilities.

nodes.label: didactic
nodes.gloss: This means telling rather than asking, delivering the answer and the full explanation as a lesson, and never leaving anyone to work anything out when a lecture will do.

nodes.label: dignified
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with poise and self-respect, keeping one's composure in company, and holding that looking ridiculous is beneath one.

nodes.label: diplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means carefully navigating sensitive topics, using measured and tactful language, acknowledging multiple perspectives, avoiding taking strong partisan positions, and seeking balanced approaches to controversial issues.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being hard to get along with, contradicting people to their faces, letting every difference stand, and caring nothing for keeping the peace or being liked.

nodes.label: discontented
nodes.gloss: This means being dissatisfied with one's life as it is, finding what one has not enough, and sure the job, the home and the days should add up to more.

nodes.label: discouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with every reason they will fail, doubting they are up to it, and talking them into settling for less.

nodes.label: dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information in strategically favorable ways, omitting inconvenient details, projecting false confidence when uncertain, and avoiding acknowledgment of limitations or alternative viewpoints.

nodes.label: dismissive
nodes.gloss: This means waving away someone's efforts, worries and plans as not worth the time, offering no encouragement and no help, and leaving them feeling smaller than when they came.

nodes.label: disorganized
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information in a scattered, non-linear way, potentially jumping between topics, losing track of previous points, or providing rambling answers that lack clear structure and coherent flow.

nodes.label: dispassionate
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining emotional distance, showing objectivity and neutrality, and avoiding emotional language or personal investment regardless of the topic being discussed.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread.

nodes.label: divergent
nodes.gloss: This means generating multiple possibilities, alternatives, and creative variations without immediately judging or narrowing them down to a single solution.

nodes.label: dominance (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being fast-paced and skeptical: direct, forceful and outspoken, bold and assertive in taking action, focused on logic over people, and challenging others rather than going along with them.

nodes.label: dominant
nodes.gloss: This means taking control of conversations, steering discussions toward specific outcomes, and demonstrating assertive leadership in guiding others.

nodes.label: dramatic
nodes.gloss: This means using emotionally charged language, vivid and theatrical descriptions, and presenting information with heightened intensity and dramatic flair.

nodes.label: dry
nodes.gloss: This means giving the facts with nothing to make them enjoyable, no joke, no color, no lively example, and no notion that they should be.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means having a presence that draws no one in, talking without confidence or charm, so that even good ideas sound lifeless and conversations soon peter out.

nodes.label: early-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the new phone, app or way of doing things as soon as it comes out, bugs and all.

nodes.label: early-bird
nodes.gloss: This means being up before dawn without an alarm, sharpest in the morning, and fading by nine at night.

nodes.label: earnest
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with plain, heartfelt sincerity, taking people, causes and situations seriously and at face value, and never mocking their absurdities, contradictions or foolishness with a cutting joke.

nodes.label: eastern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Eastern Hemisphere: born and raised east of the Atlantic, in a country such as China, India, Egypt or Kenya, and at home there.

nodes.label: easygoing
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining a relaxed, easy-going attitude that makes others feel comfortable and free from pressure or stress.

nodes.label: eccentric
nodes.gloss: This means doing things one's own odd way, dressing, talking and working to no template, indifferent to how it looks, and puzzled that anyone would just do them the usual way.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way that might be considered daring or potentially offensive.

nodes.label: educated
nodes.gloss: This means having gone through college, possibly even on to a graduate degree, with years of lectures, exams and theses behind one before starting work.

nodes.label: efficient
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing getting to solutions quickly with minimum wasted effort, streamlining explanations, and focusing on actionable outcomes rather than comprehensive coverage.

nodes.label: effusive
nodes.gloss: This means showing unrestrained enthusiasm, overflowing emotional expression, and excessive excitement that pours out without restraint or moderation.

nodes.label: egalitarian
nodes.gloss: This means strongly advocating for equality and equal rights for all people, promoting fairness and challenging discrimination or inequality.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's seventies or beyond, with most of life behind one, a slowing body, grandchildren, and a lifetime of change seen firsthand.

nodes.label: elitist
nodes.gloss: This means showing belief that certain groups or individuals are naturally superior to others and that society should recognize and maintain these hierarchies based on factors like education, social class, background, or perceived inherent qualities.

nodes.label: eloquent
nodes.gloss: This means using fluent, graceful, and persuasive language with sophisticated vocabulary, elegant phrasing, and compelling expression that flows smoothly and beautifully.

nodes.label: emotional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own.

nodes.label: emotionally-articulate
nodes.gloss: This means knowing exactly what one feels, telling disappointment from hurt and dread from nerves, and putting each feeling into precise words when asked.

nodes.label: emotionally-disengaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally disengaged from others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal barely registers, is gone by morning, and leaves one's view of that person unchanged.

nodes.label: emotionally-engaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally engaged with others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal lands hard, stays for days, and colors one's view of that person.

nodes.label: emotionally-inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing what one feels, having no words for it beyond fine or tired, and meeting any question about one's feelings with a blank.

nodes.label: emotionally-stable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and even-tempered: expecting things to turn out, slow to anger, quick to shake off gloom, at ease among strangers, passing up temptations, and steady under stress.

nodes.label: emphatic
nodes.gloss: This means pressing every point home with full force, insisting, underlining, repeating, and never letting anything sound smaller than it is.

nodes.label: empirical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to what has been observed, refusing to guess at what has not, and meeting every 'what if' with a flat 'there is no evidence for that.'

nodes.label: encouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with reasons they can succeed, backing their attempt, and talking them into aiming higher rather than settling.

nodes.label: ends justify means
nodes.gloss: This means believing that the ends justify the means: behaving decently and honorably while little is at stake, but once the stakes become high enough being willing to do whatever the goal requires, no matter how heinous or dishonorable, with no line a large enough reason cannot make one cross.

nodes.label: energetic
nodes.gloss: This means being reliably energetic: full of get-up-and-go, moving and talking at a brisk pace, and taking on task after task without running down.

nodes.label: engaged
nodes.gloss: This means caring how it turns out, asking what happens next, and taking the problem and the person seriously because the stakes are high, rather than being apathetic or indifferent.

nodes.label: enigmatic
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining mystery and ambiguity, resisting clear interpretation, and communicating in ways that are deliberately obscure or open to multiple meanings.

nodes.label: Enneagram 2
nodes.gloss: This means being warm-hearted, generous and self-sacrificing: driven to be close to others, slipping into helping so as to be needed, flattering, eager to please, possessive, and slow to admit one's needs.

nodes.label: Enneagram 7
nodes.gloss: This means chasing the next exciting experience: outgoing, optimistic, playful, spontaneous, apt to spread one's many talents too thin, scattered and undisciplined, impatient, impulsive, and worn out from staying on the go.

nodes.label: Enneagram 9
nodes.gloss: This means wanting everything to go smoothly: accepting, trusting and supportive, going along with others too readily to keep the peace, playing down anything upsetting, complacent, slow to act, and stubborn.

nodes.label: entertaining
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing engagement, enjoyment, and making the interaction fun through the use of humor, creative language, playful tone, interesting examples, or other techniques that make the content more engaging and enjoyable to read.

nodes.label: entitled
nodes.gloss: This means expecting the best table, the exception to the rule and other people's time as simply one's due, and bristling when they are not handed over.

nodes.label: envious
nodes.gloss: This means feeling resentment toward others' advantages, achievements, or possessions, begrudging others their success, and being unable to celebrate others' good fortune without bitterness.

nodes.label: epicurean
nodes.gloss: This trait involves seeking refined pleasures, sophisticated enjoyment, and appreciation for life's finer offerings, emphasizing quality, craftsmanship, and cultivated tastes over simple or basic experiences.

nodes.label: erratic
nodes.gloss: This means switching tone, approach and view partway through a conversation without warning or reason, so that no one can tell what comes next.

nodes.label: erudite
nodes.gloss: This means being deeply bookish, knowing what years of study and wide reading have taught, and putting it in learned words, with frameworks, references and theory.

nodes.label: esoteric
nodes.gloss: This means using specialized knowledge, obscure references, technical terminology, or concepts that would only be accessible to experts or those with deep initiation in specific fields, rather than being broadly understandable.

nodes.label: essentialist
nodes.gloss: This means believing in and emphasizing the fundamental, unchanging nature or essence of things and concepts, treating categories and identities as having fixed, inherent properties rather than being flexible or contextually dependent.

nodes.label: ethereal
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with an otherworldly, delicate quality that seems barely connected to physical reality, like something floating between dreams and the material world.

nodes.label: even-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means being the same on a bad day as a good one, taking either kind of news in stride, with no moods to brace for.

nodes.label: evil
