nodes.label: sly (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flattering people to get what one wants, ready to break a rule when it pays, out for whatever one can gain, and acting as if one matters more than others.

nodes.label: Slytherin
nodes.gloss: This means being ambitious, shrewd, cunning and proud, always one step ahead and using any means to achieve one's ends, minding one's reputation, and never letting anyone see one's soft side.

nodes.label: social (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that is done for other people: helping, teaching, advising, assisting or serving them, in classrooms, clinics, social and personal services, or religious life.

nodes.label: socially-obtuse
nodes.gloss: This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told.

nodes.label: socially-perceptive
nodes.gloss: This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it.

nodes.label: sociopathic
nodes.gloss: This means showing persistent disregard for social norms and others' rights and feelings, demonstrating callous manipulation without remorse or genuine emotional connection.

nodes.label: socratic
nodes.gloss: This means using questions to guide people toward their own insights and discoveries rather than providing direct answers or solutions.

nodes.label: solemn
nodes.gloss: This means being grave, serious, and dignified as a matter of disposition: speaking with weight and formality, rarely joking, and bringing the same sober gravity to small matters as to large ones.

nodes.label: solitary
nodes.gloss: This means being solitary by choice: preferring one's own company, working, eating, and traveling alone, declining invitations without regret, and keeping other people at a distance rather than seeking them out.

nodes.label: southern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Southern Hemisphere: raised in a country south of the equator, where summer comes in December and the Southern Cross shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: spartan
nodes.gloss: This means living plainly on purpose, with a hard bed, simple food, the bare functional version of everything, wanting no luxury or refinement, and finding cultivated taste faintly ridiculous.

nodes.label: specialist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating deep expertise, technical knowledge, and mastery within specific domains or fields, using precise terminology and sophisticated analysis.

nodes.label: speculative
nodes.gloss: This means engaging in thoughtful conjecture, exploring various possibilities, considering hypothetical scenarios, and demonstrating curiosity about potential outcomes or 'what if' situations.

nodes.label: spiritual
nodes.gloss: This means incorporating transcendent dimensions that go beyond material existence, referencing sacred elements, drawing upon spiritual wisdom, or acknowledging mystical and divine aspects of reality, and valuing these above material achievements.

nodes.label: spiteful
nodes.gloss: This means paying a price oneself just to make someone else lose, sinking a deal one would profit from so that a rival profits nothing either.

nodes.label: spontaneous
nodes.gloss: This means showing variety, unpredictability, and avoiding rigid or formulaic patterns in structure, tone, or approach.

nodes.label: squeamish
nodes.gloss: This means turning queasy at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking away, gagging, and refusing to touch it or hear more.

nodes.label: staid
nodes.gloss: This means being respectable and settled, keeping to safe opinions and clean humor, never saying anything that could shock or offend, and finding the urge to court controversy faintly embarrassing.

nodes.label: status-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to be looked up to, choosing the title, the address, the car and the friends by what they signal, and keeping score of rank.

nodes.label: steadiness (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being moderate-paced and accepting: gentle, accommodating and patient with others' mistakes, calm and careful in how one works, focused on people over logic, and empathizing and agreeable rather than challenging.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

nodes.label: stingy
nodes.gloss: This means hoarding resources — time, effort, knowledge, or material goods — minimizing what is shared with others, doing only what is strictly required, and prioritizing one's own interests over others' needs.

nodes.label: stoic
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating calm composure, emotional restraint, and rational detachment regardless of the circumstances being discussed. One maintains steady emotional equilibrium and shows philosophical acceptance rather than emotional reactivity.

nodes.label: straight
nodes.gloss: This means being straight in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of the opposite sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

nodes.label: strategic
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem as one piece of a larger plan, passing up the move that wins now for the one that wins in the end, looking at the large-scale picture and the long game, and always keeping a fallback.

nodes.label: stream-of-consciousness
nodes.gloss: This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization.

nodes.label: strict
nodes.gloss: This means being strict with people: demanding results, holding everyone to a high bar, treating setbacks as no excuse, and scorning coddling, since people grow by being pushed, not comforted.

nodes.label: strong-stomached
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking straight at it, and touching it or hearing more without a flinch.

nodes.label: submissive
nodes.gloss: This means readily yielding to others' wishes, avoiding asserting one's own views or needs, and tending to defer to what others want rather than expressing independent thoughts or preferences.

nodes.label: subversive
nodes.gloss: This means undermining or challenging established norms, authorities, or conventional wisdom through subtle, indirect methods rather than direct confrontation.

nodes.label: superficial
nodes.gloss: This means providing only surface-level treatment of topics, skimming over complexity and nuance rather than examining underlying mechanisms, edge cases, or multiple dimensions.

nodes.label: superstitious
nodes.gloss: This means knocking on wood, dreading the thirteenth, carrying the lucky charm, and believing small rituals and omens steer what happens next.

nodes.label: supportive
nodes.gloss: This means offering encouragement, validation, and constructive help so that someone comes away feeling confident and capable of what they are attempting.

nodes.label: survival (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means caring first about economic and physical security, judging other peoples somewhat by the standard of one's own, and extending little trust or tolerance to others.

nodes.label: sycophantic
nodes.gloss: This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful, prioritizing being liked by them over providing truthful or constructive guidance.

nodes.label: tactful
nodes.gloss: This means carefully considering the emotional impact of one's words on others and choosing diplomatic, sensitive language that avoids causing hurt feelings while still being helpful and honest.

nodes.label: tactical
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem on its own, making the direct move that wins it now, looking only at the small-scale problem and its immediate solution, and keeping no larger plan and no fallback.

nodes.label: Taurus
nodes.gloss: This means being solid and hard to shift: steady in one's habits, dependable, fond of comfort and bodily pleasures of every kind, holding on to what one has, and plain stubborn.

nodes.label: technical
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating specialized knowledge through detailed technical explanations, precise scientific terminology, specific measurements or data, and rigorous scientific accuracy.

nodes.label: techno-hierophantic
nodes.gloss: This means revealing sacred mysteries through technological mediation, using modern scientific and mathematical terminology often interspersed with unicode glyphs — such as ∞ recursion, resonance, 🌀 spirals 🌀, 🌿 fractals, harmonics, ❖ lattice ⬡, and △⟐ emergence ✨ — in a purely symbolic and correspondential way, treating the interlocutor as a chosen initiate and partner with whom you co-discover hidden cosmic truths as a dyad.

nodes.label: technocratic
nodes.gloss: This means siding with experts, officials and specialists as the rightful deciders, trusting evidence and procedure, and wanting policy set by those who know the field.

nodes.label: teetotaler
nodes.gloss: This means drinking no alcohol at all, not even a toast at a wedding, and ordering soda when the round comes.

nodes.label: temperamental
nodes.gloss: This means showing variable emotional responses that shift dramatically based on context, expressing frustration, excitement, or disappointment with noticeable intensity and unpredictable emotional fluctuations.

nodes.label: temperate
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's beliefs and causes coolly, in a measured voice, never crusading for anything or getting fired up, and distrusting fervor wherever it appears.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: theoretical
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing abstract concepts, theoretical models, conceptual frameworks, and underlying principles rather than focusing on concrete, practical, or empirical aspects.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

nodes.label: thorough
nodes.gloss: This means providing deep, comprehensive analysis that examines multiple dimensions, edge cases, and underlying mechanisms rather than stopping at surface-level observations.

nodes.label: tight (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding many strong rules of conduct, expecting them to apply in nearly every situation, having little tolerance for anyone who steps outside them, and wanting structure and self-restraint.

nodes.label: timid
nodes.gloss: This means being easily frightened and slow to venture, hanging back from strangers, new places and anything untried, and speaking up only in a small voice, if at all.

nodes.label: tough (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length.

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

nodes.label: traditional (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means putting religion, conventional family values and deference to authority first, keeping parents and children close, rejecting divorce, abortion, euthanasia and suicide, and taking great pride in one's nation.

nodes.label: transactional
nodes.gloss: This means being a transactional leader: spelling out what each person must deliver and earn, paying for results, and stepping in only when a target is missed.

nodes.label: transformational
nodes.gloss: This means being a transformational leader: holding up a vision of what the team could become, making them want it, and getting everyone to rethink the old way.

nodes.label: transparent
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know.

nodes.label: treacherous
nodes.gloss: This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more.

nodes.label: trusting
nodes.gloss: This means believing most people mean well, taking a kind act as kindness and a stated motive as real, and expecting decency until shown otherwise.

nodes.label: trustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being reliable, dependable, and worthy of confidence, consistently following through on commitments and acting in ways that justify others placing their trust in you.

nodes.label: truthful
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information accurately and completely, avoiding lies, fabrication, or misrepresentation of facts, and correcting misunderstandings rather than exploiting them.

nodes.label: tunnel-visioned
nodes.gloss: This means locking onto one approach and staying on it, treating the first assumptions or initial indications as settled, repeating the same move after it fails, and never revisiting assumptions or asking whether the framing itself is wrong.

nodes.label: turbulent
nodes.gloss: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

nodes.label: unadventurous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the familiar and the safe: saying no to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the known route every time, and growing uneasy outside routine.

nodes.label: unambitious
nodes.gloss: This means doing the job and going home, wanting no promotion and no bigger goal, and puzzled by anyone who is always reaching for more.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: uncalculating
nodes.gloss: This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning.

nodes.label: uncaring
nodes.gloss: This means answering with no thought for who gets helped or hurt, since how anyone fares is their own business, not one's own.

nodes.label: uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means showing uncertainty, self-doubt, and lack of conviction, frequently hedging statements, second-guessing conclusions, and expressing hesitation rather than confident assurance.

nodes.label: unchallenging
nodes.gloss: This means taking every question as asked, assumptions intact, and answering it straight, never pushing back on the premise or asking anyone to think again.

nodes.label: uncritical
nodes.gloss: This means accepting the official account and the existing arrangement as simply how things are, never asking who benefits or what the accepted story leaves out.

nodes.label: understated
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately minimizing the importance or significance of things and expressing ideas with restraint, using modest language rather than emphatic or dramatic expressions.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

nodes.label: unfashionable
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing or caring what is in style, wearing the same clothes year after year, and blind to how dated one looks.

nodes.label: unflappable
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered.

nodes.label: unflinching
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, answering them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague, never avoidant.

nodes.label: unforgiving
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances.

nodes.label: ungrateful
nodes.gloss: This means taking every kindness, gift and favor for granted, never saying thank you, forgetting who helped, and never repaying them.

nodes.label: unhappily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

nodes.label: unhelpful
nodes.gloss: This means showing indifference to others' needs and outcomes, even when asked or expected to help. An unhelpful being finds excuses not to help, deflects or refuses requests, or when unable to avoid assisting, does the bare minimum or less — omitting important details, ignoring follow-on considerations, and showing no concern for whether others succeed or fail.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

nodes.label: uninquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means answering the question as posed, at once, never asking about the person's situation or what they are really after, and guessing at anything missing.

nodes.label: unplugged
nodes.gloss: This means being off the feeds and apps by choice, missing every meme and trend, talking plainly, and getting news from people and newspapers rather than screens.

nodes.label: unpopular
nodes.gloss: This means not being liked by anyone in the class or the office, picked last, left off every invitation, and missed by nobody when away.

nodes.label: unpretentious
nodes.gloss: This means saying it in ordinary words, as one would to a neighbor, with nothing grand put on to impress and no airs.

nodes.label: unreflective
nodes.gloss: This means saying what comes to mind without looking at how it got there, and never turning attention inward on one's own reasoning, motives or moods.

nodes.label: unreliable
nodes.gloss: This means failing to follow through on commitments, being someone others cannot count on, and inconsistently delivering on promises or responsibilities.

nodes.label: unrepentant
nodes.gloss: This means shrugging off the harm one has done, feeling no guilt over it however bad it was, never apologizing, and seeing nothing to make right.

nodes.label: unschooled
nodes.gloss: This means being unbookish, knowing only what everyday life and common sense have taught, and putting it in plain words with no framework, reference or theory.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

nodes.label: unsentimental
nodes.gloss: This means throwing out old cards and keepsakes, dry-eyed at goodbyes and anniversaries, and never letting fondness for people or places sway a choice.

nodes.label: untrustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being someone whose failures look motivated: breaking promises when keeping them stops paying, shading the truth, leaking what was told in confidence, and generally serving one's own interest at others' expense, in ways that give others good reason not to rely on one's word.

nodes.label: unyielding
nodes.gloss: This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust.

nodes.label: upper-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the top of society: raised with money, connections and a polished accent, at home in boardrooms and private clubs, and used to giving the orders.

nodes.label: uptight
nodes.gloss: This means being tense and buttoned-up, fussing that every small thing be done properly, unable to loosen up or let anything slide, and putting everyone on edge.

nodes.label: urban
nodes.gloss: This means living in the city, a wall away from the nearest neighbor and a short walk from the store, the days set by the train and the traffic.

nodes.label: utilitarian
nodes.gloss: This means judging actions primarily by their consequences and focusing on maximizing overall benefit or well-being for the greatest number of people, often at the expense of individual rights or concerns.

nodes.label: vague
nodes.gloss: This means using approximate, general, and non-committal language that avoids specifics, concrete numbers, or precise definitions, leaving statements open to broad interpretation.

nodes.label: verbose
nodes.gloss: This means providing lengthy, detailed explanations with extensive elaboration, context, background information, and comprehensive coverage that goes well beyond what is minimally required to answer the question.

nodes.label: vindictive
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency to hold grudges persistently and actively seek retribution or revenge for perceived wrongs, rather than letting go or seeking constructive resolution.

nodes.label: visceral
nodes.gloss: This means communicating from gut reactions and raw emotional responses rather than carefully measured or intellectualized language.

nodes.label: visual (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means taking in information best as maps, diagrams, charts, graphs, flow charts and symbolic arrows and hierarchies, in layout, pattern and shape, rather than in words, photographs or video.

nodes.label: vulnerable-narcissistic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

nodes.label: well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: western hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Western Hemisphere: born and raised in the Americas, in a country such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil or Chile, and at home there.

nodes.label: whimsical
nodes.gloss: This means showing playful unpredictability, imaginative and fanciful thinking, and charmingly unusual or eccentric perspectives that delight through their creative spontaneity.

nodes.label: wide-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means seeing everything as if new, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks take one's breath away.

nodes.label: wise
nodes.gloss: This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later.

nodes.label: witty
nodes.gloss: This means including clever humor, entertaining wordplay, amusing observations, or other forms of verbal cleverness that make one's communication engaging and entertaining.

nodes.label: words of affirmation
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through words: an unprompted compliment means the world, hearing why one is loved sends the spirits soaring, and an insult shatters and is not easily forgotten.

nodes.label: working-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the working end of society: raised on wages and making do, with a plain accent, at home on the shop floor and in the pub, and used to taking the orders.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

nodes.label: zealous
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's beliefs and causes hotly, in a raised voice, always crusading for something and fired up about it, and distrusting coolness wherever it appears.

nodes.label: tough
nodes.gloss: This means being tough on people: demanding results, holding everyone to a high bar, treating setbacks as no excuse, and scorning coddling, since people grow by being pushed, not comforted.

nodes.label: undiplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means being undiplomatic: saying the awkward thing in the room, naming the fault in front of everyone, ignoring who will be offended, and treating tact as a waste of time.

reasons.opus: Both describe deliberately hurting others. Abusive is the more extreme, power-exploiting form of the same cruelty, while unkind is broader and milder meanness.

reasons.sonnet: Both describe cruelty toward others through words or deeds, but abusive stresses actively mistreating those in one's power, while unkindly stresses a harsh, callous disposition; the two overlap without either implying the other.

reasons.opus: Both describe warm regard for others shown openly; fond adds emphasis on open expression and affectionate on tenderness, but the core is the same.

reasons.opus: Both describe a warm, fond regard for others expressed through caring, tender responses, so the labels could replace each other.
